title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Netherlands.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

Accountabilities
In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

- Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

- Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

- Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

- Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

- Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

- Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

- Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

- Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

- Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

- Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected:

- Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

- Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences.

- Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments.

- Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance.

- Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning.

- Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

- Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI.

- Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

- Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability.

- Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance.

- Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV.

- Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions.

Benefits

- Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team.

- International Collaboration: Collaborate with talented researchers, engineers, and technology professionals across different countries and disciplines.

- Cutting-Edge AI Research: Work on advanced reinforcement learning, multimodal architectures, generative AI, and next-generation intelligent systems.

- Research and Innovation: Explore new methodologies and contribute to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence.

- Scientific Recognition: Opportunities to publish research and present findings at leading international AI and machine learning conferences.

- Professional Growth: Develop expertise in emerging AI technologies while contributing to challenging, high-impact research initiatives.

- Global Technology Environment: Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing organization working across AI, digital finance, peer-to-peer technology, and other innovative fields.

title: AI Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.

Accountabilities
You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

- Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

- Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.

- Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.

- Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.

- Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.

- Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.

- Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.

- Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.

- Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.

- Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.

- Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.

- Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

- Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations.

- At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred.

- Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight.

- Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one.

- Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems.

- Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems.

- Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data.

- Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments.

- Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes.

- Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems.

- Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript.

- Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV.

- A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction.

- Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.

- Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI.

Benefits

- Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years.

- Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one.

- Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research.

- Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data.

- Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries.

- Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability

At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

- Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems.
- Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance.
- Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware.
- Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems.
- Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces.
- Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning.
- Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error.
- Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software.
Who you are

- An senior embedded software engineer with 8+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems.
- Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints.
- Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
- Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers.
- Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them.
- Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour.
- Curious about FPGA-adjacent workflows and comfortable interfacing with low-level logic when required.
- Motivated by building flight-critical software in a small team where your code directly affects system behaviour.
What we offer

- A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
- Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
- High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
- A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
- A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
- Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. Security and Eligibility Requirement

Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

- Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations.

- Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms.

- Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies.

title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
description:
Build what most people think is impossible.

Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability.

We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people.

Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before.

We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment.

The Opportunity
This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do.

You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes.

Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as:

- Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations. The exact problem matters less than how you approach it.

You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions.

If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it.

Who we are looking for

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
What you'll do

- Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems.
- Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance.
- Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware.
- Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems.
- Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces.
- Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning.
- Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error.
- Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software.
Who you are

- An embedded software engineer with 3+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems.
- Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints.
- Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
- Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers.
- Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them.
- Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour.
- Curious about FPGA-adjacent workflows and comfortable interfacing with low-level logic when required.
- Motivated by building flight-critical software in a small team where your code directly affects system behaviour.
What we offer

- A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
- Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
- High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
- A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
- A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
- Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. Security and Eligibility Requirement

Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

title: Senior Brand Activation Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼

Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im eigenen Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt nach Hause: einfach, schnell und stilvoll. Unsere Projekte und Brand-Kampagnen wachsen rasant, und dafür brauchen wir vor allem eines: mehr Execution Power.

Und genau hier kommst DU ins Spiel.

Als Senior Brand Activation Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Community-Brand-Aktivierungen und Offline-Kampagnen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Setups, steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen echte, messbare Brand-Momente werden. Die Rolle ist hands-on und operativ stark und gleichzeitig strategisch entscheidend dafür, wie Doonails als Marke wahrgenommen wird.

Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️
Du bringst Struktur, Klarheit und Energie in unsere Brand-Projekte und ermöglichst eine starke Zusammenarbeit im Team. Mit hochwertigen Offline-Aktivierungen machst du Doonails erlebbar und steigerst unsere Brand Awareness spürbar. Gleichzeitig baust du Brand Activation als skalierbaren Bereich mit klarer Ownership weiter aus – für Qualität, Konsistenz und Tempo in allem, was wir gemeinsam umsetzen.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben 👩‍💻👨‍💻
Brand Activation & Campaign Management

- Du bist verantwortlich für die Planung von Events, Pop-ups, Tours, Launches und Offline-Kampagnen.

End-to-End-Projektmanagement

- Von der ersten Timeline über die Budgetüberwachung bis hin zum finalen Qualitätscheck behältst du alle Fäden sicher in der Hand.

Koordination externer Partner & Dienstleister

- Das lückenlose Briefing und die Verhandlung externer Partner, darunter Locations, Messebauer, Produktionsteams, Deko und Technik, fallen voll in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.

Markenauftritt

- In engem Schulterschluss mit dem Brand Design Team stellst du sicher, dass Doonails an jedem physischen Touchpoint konsistent, hochwertig und stilvoll erlebbar wird.

Steigerung der Brand Awareness

- Die gezielte Steigerung unserer Brand Awareness treibst du aktiv voran, machst Erfolge anhand klarer KPIs messbar und leitest wertvolle Reportings ab.

Stakeholder Management & Kommunikation

- Sowohl intern über verschiedene Departments hinweg als auch extern gegenüber Kooperationspartnern fungierst du als souveräne, lösungsorientierte Drehscheibe.

Das bringst du mit 🤝

- Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Beauty, Fashion oder Lifestyle und nachweisbare Erfahrung in Brand Activation & Event Management

- Projektmanagement: Exzellente Projektmanagement-Skills im Multi-Projekt-Setup

- Partner- & Netzwerkkompetenz: Erfahrung im Vendor-, Agentur- und Dienstleister-Management

- Kommunikationsstärke: Starkes Stakeholder Management

- Reisebereitschaft: für den Aufbau, die Begleitung und das Monitoring unserer Events, Pop-ups und Kampagnen direkt am Geschehen, damit jeder Markenmoment perfekt sitzt.
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir dir bieten 💖

- 💸 Faire Bezahlung, angepasst an deine Qualifikation & Erfahrung

- 🤝 Ein echtes Ownership-Rollenprofil mit viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum

- 🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland: arbeite flexibel von überall

- 📈 Wachstumspotenzial: übernimm Verantwortung & bring deine Ideen direkt ein

- 📚 1.300 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr für deine persönliche Entwicklung

- 🧘 Nilo Health, denn mentale Gesundheit ist uns wichtig und dein Zugang ist inklusive

- 💪🏼 Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft

title: Senior SAP Transportation Management Consultant (f/m/d)
description:
Join Westernacher’s SAP Transportation Management practice and help leading companies transform complex transportation and logistics processes. You will work on end-to-end SAP TM implementations across different industries, contributing your expertise within an experienced international consulting team.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Design and implement end-to-end transportation management processes using SAP TM.
- Take ownership of functional workstreams, from requirements analysis and solution design through configuration, testing and go-live support.
- Translate business requirements into practical SAP TM solutions and functional specifications.
- Facilitate customer workshops, evaluate solution options and provide clear recommendations for process improvement.
- Collaborate with customers, developers and cross-functional SAP teams to ensure integrated, high-quality solutions.
- Plan and deliver project work packages while contributing to knowledge sharing and the development of less experienced colleagues.
Your Expertise

- At least 5 to 7 years of relevant SAP TM consulting experience.
- Functional expertise demonstrated across at least three full-cycle SAP implementations.
- Strong SAP TM configuration and solution design skills.
- Good understanding of end-to-end transportation and logistics processes, supported by relevant cross-module knowledge.
- Excellent German and good English communication skills.
- Willingness to travel based on project requirements.
Why Join Westernacher

- Partnership culture with the opportunity for co‑ownership in a 100% employee‑owned company.
- A diverse and versatile role with real opportunities to shape your career in an entrepreneurial environment.
- Inspiring, inclusive, and supportive global working culture
- Open communication, trust, and regular feedback within a flat organizational structure.
- Opportunity to work on complex and innovative projects across multiple industries.
- Competitive remuneration package.
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.

Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients.

We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another.

Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

We are looking for a Principal SAP IBP Consultant (f/m/d) to join our Supply Chain Planning team in Germany. In this senior consulting role, you will lead complex SAP Integrated Business Planning initiatives, advise customers on their planning strategy and help develop our SAP IBP capabilities.


How You’ll Make an Impact
  • Lead complex, end-to-end SAP IBP implementations, from planning and solution design through implementation and delivery.
  • Advise senior customer stakeholders on planning strategies and translate business requirements into scalable SAP IBP solutions.
  • Mentor consultants and architects, supporting knowledge sharing, capability development and consistent delivery quality.
  • Contribute to pre-sales activities, including solution definition, estimations, proposals and customer presentations.

Your Expertise
  • At least 8 years of SAP consulting experience, with deep SAP IBP and supply chain planning expertise, including leading complex implementations and designing integrated solutions.
    • Experience advising senior and executive stakeholders, combined with strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
    • Experience in mentoring consultants, supporting pre-sales activities and contributing to customer or portfolio development.
    • Excellent German and English skills, with willingness to travel according to project and customer needs.

    Why Join Westernacher
  • Partnership culture with the opportunity for co-ownership in an employee-owned company.
  • Varied responsibilities and the freedom to shape your career in an entrepreneurial environment.
  • Complex SAP transformation projects across different industries.
  • Supportive international teams built on collaboration, trust and open communication.
  • Competitive remuneration and benefits.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model.
    • Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients. 
     
    We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another. 
     
    Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law.

title: Senior Account Executive (Government, Defense & Intelligence)
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the role

This is a rare opportunity to build and lead Kpler’s growth across Continental Europe’s defense and intelligence community. You will own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed contract and beyond, working with ministries, agencies and public sector institutions where our data directly supports national security and policy decisions.

If you are a natural hunter who thrives on complex, high-value deals and wants your work to matter, this role offers real ownership, visibility and impact.

What you will do

- Win new business. Own the end-to-end sales cycle, identifying, pursuing and closing high-value opportunities across government accounts.
- Grow what we have. Manage strategic existing accounts, uncovering upsell and cross-sell potential.
- Navigate the public sector. Lead us through tenders, RFPs and long procurement processes to win and retain contracts.
- Build lasting relationships. Become a trusted partner to senior decision-makers across ministries, agencies and institutional clients.
- Drive regional growth. Deliver ambitious revenue targets and shape our strategy for the region.
- Work as one team. Partner with Customer Success, Marketing and Product so clients get the most value from Kpler’s solutions.
- Keep the pipeline sharp. Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in the CRM to support data-driven decisions.
- Be the face of Kpler. Represent us at industry events, conferences and client meetings.

What you bring

- Experience in SaaS/DaaS/data platform sales to government institutions is a plus.
- A proven track record of hunter-style sales, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets
- Deep knowledge of government procurement, including tenders and RFPs
- A strong professional network you can put to work from day one
- Experience managing large, strategic accounts in multi-stakeholder environments
- A consultative approach to selling, paired with a competitive, results-driven mindset
- The ability to juggle multiple complex opportunities in a fast-paced, high-growth setting
- Fluent English and at least one other major European language (e.g. French, German, Spanish, Italian)

We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.

Our People Pledge

Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the Staff Privacy Notice

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Platform & Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.

What You Will Do

- Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and development of systems that enable and enhance partner and platform experiences across devices and integrations
- Drive complex technical initiatives that span multiple studios or a full mission — particularly where coordination cost, architectural sprawl, or competing local optimizations are part of the problem
- Create leverage by unifying fragmented approaches, retiring duplicative systems, and establishing the standards and platforms that enable multiple studios move faster without reinventing foundations — judging where consolidation creates leverage and where local autonomy is the better choice
- Define and influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries and bring other senior engineers along in executing it
- Collaborate with engineering, product and design leaders across the Experience Mission and beyond to identify shared opportunities, align technical direction and reduce duplication
- Shape how AI transforms the software development lifecycle and pioneer AI-native workflows and capabilities that bridge engineering, product, and design

Who You Are

- You have deep experience designing, building and operating distributed systems that serve users at scale
- You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built
- You thrive in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and can identify where technical investment will create the greatest leverage across teams and systems
- You care deeply about reliable, high-quality user experiences powered by data and personalization
- You actively explore how AI reshapes how we build, not just what we build, and can turn emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how teams work
- You bring a thoughtful, collaborative, inclusive mindset and actively contribute to a positive team culture

Where You Will Be

- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. For this role, you can be based anywhere in EMEA where Spotify has a work location (excluding France due to on-call restrictions).
- The team collaborates within Central European and GMT time zones. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Pflichtpraktikum Recruiting & KI (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben im Praktikum

Ich bin Leon, selbstständiger Personalvermittler im Raum München. Ich besetze Stellen vom Handwerk bis IT, dazu Projekte im Executive Bereich. Bei mir lernst du das komplette Handwerk der Personalvermittlung von innen, nicht als Zuschauer, sondern mit eigener Verantwortung ab Woche eins.

Dein Kernprojekt ist der Ausbau unserer Neukundengewinnung über persönlich adressierte Briefe an Geschäftsführer, gestartet in der Region München, inzwischen deutschlandweit im Ausbau. Ein Kanal, der bei uns nachweislich funktioniert.

Konkret heißt das:

- Du steuerst die Firmenrecherche: Die Fleißarbeit übernimmt KI, du prüfst die Ergebnisse und entscheidest, wer angeschrieben wird. Wie das geht, zeige ich dir

- Du bereitest die Briefe vor, bis zum druckfertigen Dokument

- Du übernimmst die Nachfässe über LinkedIn und andere Kanäle und hältst nach, wer reagiert

- Du hältst unsere Pipeline sauber und weißt jederzeit, welche Firma wo im Prozess steht

- Claude, Gemini und Co sind bei uns Standardwerkzeuge, die Abos bekommst du von mir gestellt

Weil du Vollzeit dabei bist, bleibt es nicht bei einem Thema. Je nachdem, was dir liegt, übernimmst du mit der Zeit weitere Bereiche: Aufbau unseres Instagram Kanals, Kandidatensuche über Indeed und LinkedIn, erste eigene Ansprachen, später auch Telefonate und Kandidatengespräche. Du siehst bei mir, wie Akquise, Kundengespräche und Mandatssteuerung in der Praxis laufen und machst Schritt für Schritt selbst.

Was du mitbringst

- Dein Studium sieht ein Pflichtpraktikum oder Praxissemester vor, bevorzugt in Psychologie, BWL oder Sales

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und prüfst KI Ergebnisse, statt sie blind zu übernehmen

- Erfahrung mit Claude / (Code), Gemini, Higgsfield oder ähnlichen Werkzeugen ist ein Plus

- Telefonerfahrung aus Vertrieb oder Service ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

Was ich dir biete

- 99% remote, alternativ gern vor Ort in Grafing bei München, auf Wunsch mit Platz im Coworking

- Bezahltes Pflichtpraktikum

- Flexible Zeiten, Klausuren und Uni gehen vor

- KI Abos gestellt, und darüber hinaus: Willst du ein neues Tool ausprobieren, übernehme ich die Kosten bis zu einem festen Budget. Du arbeitest mit dem modernsten Setup, das es im Recruiting gerade gibt

- Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

- Bonus bei Erfolg: Trägst du zu einer Vermittlung bei, beteilige ich dich zusätzlich am Honorar

- Direktes Feedback vom Inhaber statt von einer Abteilung, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen

- Abschlussarbeit bei uns: Du kannst im Anschluss deine Bachelor oder Masterarbeit in Kooperation mit uns schreiben, mit Praxisthema aus Recruiting oder Personalmarketing, Zugang zu anonymisierten Daten und mir als festem Ansprechpartner im Unternehmen.

title: Senior Social Media Ads Manager (m/w/d), Performance & Fulfillment
description:
Senior Social Media Ads Manager (m/w/d), Performance & Fulfillment
Catapult Content GmbH · Nürnberg · Vollzeit

Wer wir sind
Catapult Content ist eine Social-Branding-Agentur für den Mittelstand. Wir bringen Handwerksbetriebe, Händler und Unternehmen aus der Region auf Social Media nach vorne, mit mehr Reichweite, mehr Kundenanfragen und mehr Bewerbungen. Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz, und was du baust, wirkt sofort.

Wen wir suchen
Keine Einsteigerin und keinen Einsteiger mit Online-Zertifikat. Wir suchen jemanden, der seit Jahren Paid Social macht, seine Zahlen kennt und Kampagnen eigenständig zum Laufen bringt. Du übernimmst bei uns das Thema Ads und entwickelst unsere Dienstleistung aktiv weiter.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact:

Dedrone stands out as the global leader in airspace defense technology and counter UAS solutions. Leveraging advanced AI/ML technologies, we deliver an all-encompassing solution for drone detection, identification, tracking, and neutralization — safeguarding critical infrastructure, governmental operations, and commercial interests from unauthorized drone activity, across both on-premise and cloud-based configurations. Engineering at Dedrone is tasked with delivering innovative solutions and products to maintain our position on the cutting-edge of innovation.

Sr. Electrical Engineers at Dedrone have full ownership of electrical system and subsystem development for next generation cUAS platforms from concept through production, whose work is highly visible to even the most senior executives. Our passionate leadership and cross-functional collaboration with mechanical engineers, firmware and software engineers, product managers, and manufacturing teams is vital to the success of the team and ensuring the safety of the general public for generations to come.

This role emphasizes high-speed electrical system architecture — spanning high-speed PCB design (FPGAs, processors, and DDR memory), RF sensor front-ends and antenna integration, firmware integration, power systems, and system-level verification. High-speed digital design is central to this role, complemented by RF design experience relevant to Dedrone's sensor hardware. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with PCB layout, mixed-signal and RF design, high-speed digital design, embedded firmware, and designing for rugged/regulated environments.

What You'll Do:

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

  •       Lead electrical system and subsystem development from concept through production, ensuring designs meet safety, EMC, and reliability standards.
  •       Define electrical architectures for RF sensors, power distribution, and control electronics for cUAS platforms.
  •       Design and review schematics and perform PCB layout for mixed‑signal, high‑speed digital, and RF boards — owning the full high‑speed PCB development lifecycle for components including FPGAs, processors, and DDR memory, with emphasis on signal integrity; partner with mechanical for packaging and thermal constraints.
  •       Lead selection and design of FPGA and processor components, applying market expertise to guide component choices and high‑performance schematic and layout decisions.
  •       Develop, validate, and optimize power systems (battery management, DC/DC, power sequencing) and ensure robust operation under shock and vibration.
  •       Perform hardware bring‑up, debugging, and system integration; use lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) to characterize high‑speed digital and RF performance.
  •       Conduct electrical analysis including signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC mitigation, thermal considerations, and reliability testing, ensuring designs meet FCC and CE compliance standards.
  •       Produce high‑fidelity prototypes and iterate quickly to qualify designs; develop test plans and lead verification and validation activities.
  •       Collaborate regularly with domestic and international stakeholders across engineering, product, and manufacturing teams.
  •       Rigorously document and manage electrical design specifications, BOMs, firmware releases, test reports, and compliance evidence (e.g., EMC, safety).

What You Bring:

  •       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  •       Proven experience in electrical design and system integration for complex hardware products, ideally in aerospace, defense, robotics, or wireless systems.
  •       Strong track record in high‑speed electrical design, including FPGAs, processors, and DDR memory subsystems, with hands‑on proficiency in Altium Designer for high‑performance schematic and layout work.
  •       Proficiency with PCB layout tools (Altium Designer preferred; OrCAD or KiCad also acceptable) and experience with DFM/DFX practices.
  •     Hands‑on experience with RF front‑ends and antenna integration, including interfacing RF front‑ends with high‑speed digital processing units; familiarity with wireless protocols relevant to cUAS (Wi‑Fi, LTE, custom radios) and experience with spectrum analysis and RF test equipment.
  •       Expertise in power electronics design: battery management systems, DC/DC converters, power sequencing, and thermal management for electronics.
  •       Solid understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC mitigation techniques, and relevant test/qualification methods, including compliance with FCC and CE standards.
  •       Experience with schematic/PCB review processes, design reviews, and partnering with manufacturing to move designs to production.
  •       Familiarity with MIL‑STD, DO‑178/DO‑254 concepts or other ruggedization and regulatory requirements for defense or industrial hardware is preferred.
  •       Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities; comfort debugging at the board and system level.
  •       Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross‑functional teams and present technical tradeoffs to stakeholders.
  •       Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment with high levels of ambiguity.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. title: Senior Project Manager BESS (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 500 Mitarbeitenden an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland. Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen.

Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.

Aufgaben, die motivieren:

- Projektmanagement von BESS-Projekten (Battery Energy Storage Systems) mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Markt

- Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

- Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

- Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

- Koordination von Nachunternehmern sowie Sicherstellung von QA/QC (Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle)

- Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei der Akquise neuer Projekte

Qualifikationen, die überzeugen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

- 6–8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektrotechnischer Anlagen in Deutschland

- Erfahrung in der Planung von Anlagen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) oder anderen elektrotechnischen Anlagen in Deutschland

- Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau

- Reisebreitschaft

- Führerschein notwendig

Worüber wir uns freuen: Wenn Sie für Ihren Job brennen, egal welcher ethnischen Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung Sie angehören. Auch Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter oder sexuelle Identität spielen für uns keine Rolle. Hauptsache, Sie passen zu uns!

91% unserer Mitarbeitenden stimmen der Aussage zu, dass ILF in Deutschland ein "Great Place to work" ist:

- Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte VIeLFalt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

- Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: An allen Standorten sind unsere Arbeitsplätze technisch hochwertig und mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet. Auch wenn es uns von anderen Unternehmen vielleicht nicht unterscheidet: Wir bieten freie Getränke, den obligatorischen Obstkorb und weitere Snacks für Zwischendurch inklusive Eis im Sommer.

- Entwicklung und Netzwerken: Wir planen für alle Mitarbeitenden jährliche Weiterbildungsbudgets ein, die für externe Angebote (z.B. Udemy) und unsere interne ILF-Academy genutzt werden können. Außerdem wird in regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen auf Wunsch die Möglichkeit neuer oder erweiterter Verantwortungsbereiche besprochen. Unsere Nachwuchskräfte treffen sich regelmäßig im Club der Jungingenieur:innen.

- Über das Gehalt hinaus: Wir beteiligen unsere Mitarbeitenden an Unternehmensgewinnen, honorieren Mitarbeiterempfehlungen sowie Fachartikel und -vorträge mit großzügigen Prämien und würdigen herausragende Projekte mit unseren Excellence Awards. Zusätzlich kann sich jeder Mitarbeitende wahlweise für eine Pluxee Guthabenkarte, eine Zusatzkrankenversicherung oder den EGYM-Wellpass entscheiden.

- Gesund und nachhaltig: Wir erstatten die monatlichen Kosten für das Jobticket und bieten die Option auf Bike-Leasing. Außerdem bezuschussen wir die Mitgliedschaft in einem Fitnessstudio und Arbeitsplatzbrillen. Bei Fragen aus allen Lebensbereichen bekommen Sie mit unserem externen Employee Assistance Program unkomplizierte und schnelle Unterstützung.

- Work-Life-Balance: Für individuelle Bedürfnisse in allen Lebenslagen finden wir passende Lösungen in Bezug auf Arbeitszeit (flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung inkl. Gleitzeitkonto und verschiedene Teilzeitvarianten) und Arbeitsort (z.B. mobiles Arbeiten, Standortwechsel, Auslandseinsätze). Zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen und Sonderurlaubstagen bei besonderen Anlässen wie z.B. Hochzeit oder Umzug sind Heiligabend und Silvester jedes Jahr frei.

- Internationalität & Vielfalt: Wir sind Teil der von den Gründerfamilien geführten ILF Gruppe mit über 45 Standorten und mehr als 3.700 Mitarbeitenden und arbeiten in nationalen sowie internationalen Projekten mit diversen Teams aus über 30 Nationen.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? description:
The Senior Director, Sales — DACH is a senior first-line sales leadership role responsible for building and driving a high-performing team of Strategic Account Executives focused on net-new logo acquisition and expansion across enterprise accounts in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH). This leader owns a significant ARR target and is accountable for the full sales cycle — from pipeline creation through close — within the DACH region.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of enterprise sales leadership and DACH market GTM strategy. You will translate Talkdesk’s business objectives into a regional execution plan, serve as a brand ambassador for the Talkdesk CX platform, and partner closely with Marketing, Product, Channel, and Customer Success to drive durable growth across this strategic European market.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and manage a team of DACH-based Strategic Account Executives focused on net-new and expansion opportunities across enterprise accounts in the region.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop AEs to drive high-quality pipeline creation, deal execution, and quota attainment across DACH-specific buying cycles and regional market nuances.

  • Foster a performance culture grounded in accountability, high empathy, and genuine investment in individual career progression.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to ensure the team is skilled on Talkdesk messaging, competitive positioning, and AI capabilities tailored to the DACH market.

Revenue & Strategy Ownership

  • Own regional DACH strategy and planning, ensuring customer retention, net-new growth, and expansion across core Talkdesk solutions — AI-powered contact center, customer experience automation, and workforce engagement management.

  • Use a data-driven approach to territory design, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline development aligned to Talkdesk’s consumption-based pricing model, adapted for local business practices in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

  • Translate Talkdesk’s business objectives into a regional DACH execution strategy, ensuring alignment with broader European and corporate goals.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline (3–4x coverage) and deliver accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts to senior leadership.

Executive Engagement & Brand

  • Actively engage with executive stakeholders at key DACH accounts; lead strategic sales meetings, attend QBRs, and build trusted long-term relationships across a localized enterprise client portfolio.

  • Serve as a brand ambassador for Talkdesk, championing our CX vision and differentiating against CCaaS competitors across the DACH market.

  • Represent Talkdesk at local industry events, conferences, and customer forums relevant to the DACH region.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Channel, and Customer Success to craft localized go-to-market campaigns, product feedback loops, and customer success programs tailored to the needs of the DACH enterprise customer base.

  • Develop and maintain deep fluency in the Talkdesk solution portfolio — including AI/automation capabilities and key ecosystem integrations (CRM, WFM, and region-specific platforms) — as well as the broader European CCaaS landscape.

  • Provide competitive intelligence and market feedback to Product, Marketing, and GTM leadership to inform roadmap, localized product requirements, and positioning decisions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  •  5+ years in a senior customer-facing sales leadership role directly managing teams in the DACH region.

  • Proven success leading teams selling to DACH enterprise accounts, with strong command of local, complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles, European procurement processes, and regional data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR).

  • Experience working for a global B2B SaaS company that has scaled successfully through rapid growth, ideally establishing a strong foothold in Central Europe.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding regional ARR targets, including net-new logo acquisition and expansion, in complex European enterprise environments.

  • Experience with 6- and 7-figure ACV deal cycles; proficiency with enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or equivalent) preferred.

  • Familiarity with CCaaS, CX technology, or adjacent platforms (UCaaS, AI/automation, WFM) strongly preferred.

  • Language skills: Native-level or completely fluent written and spoken German, and professional fluency in English.

Leadership & Team Building

  • Excellent people management skills — high empathy, strong consideration for local workplace cultures, and genuine commitment to individual career progression.

  • Experience building and scaling world-class local sales teams, including hiring, onboarding, and structured enablement across the DACH market.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach AEs through complex, multi-threaded deals and develop talent at all levels of the team.

Competencies

  • Strong command of consumption-based and SaaS pricing models; ability to translate Talkdesk’s value proposition into compelling business outcomes for DACH enterprise clients.

  • Understanding of the development and implementation of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise applications.

  • Exceptional executive communication, presence, and relationship-building skills in both German and English business contexts.

  • Ability to operate with speed and clarity in a high-growth, fast-moving environment across a dynamic regional market.

YOU’LL THRIVE AT TALKDESK IF…

  • You lead from the front — you’re in the deals, coaching in real time, and setting the standard for how the team sells in DACH.

  • You hold yourself and others accountable without losing the culture — direct, fair, and outcomes-focused.

Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

title: Director, Commissioning, EMEA
description:
Director, Commissioning, EMEA

Role Summary

The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements.

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems.

· Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles.

· Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings.

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

What We Offer

· The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA.

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.

· Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description:
We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

- Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

- Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

- Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

- Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

- Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

- Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

- Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

- Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

- Experience managing servers and infrastructure in Windows, Linux, data-centre, or hybrid environments.

- A strong interest in IT security, system reliability, access control, hardening, monitoring, and structured operations.

- The ability to troubleshoot methodically, document solutions clearly, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

- A degree, vocational qualification, professional certification, or equivalent practical experience in IT, computer science, systems engineering, or a related field.

Desirable experience/Things you will have the opportunity to support

- Classified-information requirements such as VS-NfD or higher, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar security frameworks.

- Access and permission management, system hardening, security monitoring, segregated networks, or environments with high protection requirements.

- BSI-approved cryptography or other regulated information-security requirements.

- Cloud computing, virtualisation, hypervisors such as Proxmox, virtual machines, Docker, or Kubernetes.

- Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Ansible or Terraform, together with software-development experience.

- Enterprise IT tools including mobile-device management, patch management, CMDB, ISMS, monitoring, or hardware and asset-management systems.

Benefits and important information:

- We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

- Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

- Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

- Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

- Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Account Executive, Southern Europe
description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub
