Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

About the Role

You'll be the first person a merchant contacts when something's not working. You'll own the resolution end-to-end, from first reply to final fix, and your fingerprints will be on every process we build to scale support without losing the personal touch.

Your day-to-day will be full of merchant communication, investigation and problem solving as well as project work around knowledge base, new tools, AI automation and product updates.

What You'll Do

- Own the first response for every Tebi merchant who reaches out, across chat, email, and phone

- Clear, warm communicator who can hold a merchant's confidence through chat, email, and phone

- Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

- Persistence — you don't let a ticket die in someone else's inbox

- Comfortable with scheduled on-call time

- Fluent in English and Dutch (is preferred)

- Italian and/or Spanish fluency is a strong plus!

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

title: Senior Manager Account Management
description:
About the Role

Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other.

As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard.

Why DataSnipper

The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Alwin
description:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Results You Will Drive

- Better audit outcomes: improve how accurately and reliably agents complete real audit tasks, with traceable results and human oversight.

- A faster, more efficient runtime: reduce execution time and cost while scaling to more complex workloads and larger customers.

- More capable teams: build foundations and feedback loops that multiple teams use to ship and improve agents faster.

Build & Ship

- Write production code every week on the most complex and critical parts of Alwin

- Build proofs of concept for new agent capabilities, and take the ones that work all the way to production

- Champion experimentation and R&D: try emerging models and techniques, solve hard problems creatively, and turn promising ideas into reliable features

- Build shared capabilities that multiple teams adopt, and remain accountable for whether they make those teams faster and their products more reliable

- Contribute directly to the agent harness at the core of Alwin: the orchestration, tools, context and evaluation loops every agent runs on

- Anticipate where the platform needs to be in 12 to 18 months, and make design decisions now that minimize the cost of future change

Agents in Production

- Build agents that are reliable in a regulated domain: grounding, evaluation before release, human-in-the-loop, traceability of every action

- Improve how teams build Alwin by establishing tooling and feedback loops that help them detect agent failures, prioritize improvements, prevent regressions and ship production-ready agents faster

- Jump into the hardest incidents across teams, resolve immediate problems and turn what you learn into lasting, systemic fixes

- Make the trade-offs between model cost, latency and accuracy explicit, and measure them in production

Lead by Example

- Own ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across teams: define the problem, align on the trade-offs and prove the solution in code

- Set the standard for code quality, testing and security through your own code and reviews, aligned with OWASP GenAI

- Drive AI-assisted engineering by example: try new tools, show what works and help teams adopt them

- Mentor senior engineers and grow future staff engineers by pairing, reviewing and building alongside them

- Work with Product to spot opportunities and differentiators against the competition, and shape the roadmap with what you have proven is possible

What You Bring:

- 10+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade Python, and you still write a lot of code

- Deep hands-on experience building and shipping agentic or LLM systems in production yourself (control loops, tool calling, context engineering and evaluation), with evidence that your work improved quality, reliability, speed, cost or scale

- A track record of personally solving ambiguous, high-impact problems across teams. Your work delivered measurable results and produced systems or practices that others adopted

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and growing technical leadership beyond your own team

- Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, software architecture and data modeling on a major cloud platform

- Experience with security, access control and auditability for enterprise or regulated customers

- Product sense: you know which technical bets matter for customers and the business, and have influenced product and engineering direction through evidence and clear trade-offs, without relying on formal authority

- Proficient with AI-assisted engineering, and experience driving its adoption beyond your own work

- Clear written and verbal communication, across time zones and with technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-Have

- Building platforms that other teams and customers build on

- Multi-agent orchestration or durable, long-running workflows at scale

- Retrieval and knowledge systems, or document processing (OCR, classification, structured extraction)

- Working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, Solution Architects and GTM teams on enterprise rollouts

- Experience at a scale-up going through rapid growth

- Domain experience in audit, accounting or fintech

What We Offer:

- Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

- Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

- Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

- 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

- Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

- Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

- NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

- Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

- Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

- Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

- Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

Recruitment Process

- Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

- Live coding Interview (75 minutes, online)

- System design interview (60 minutes, on-site)

- Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

title: (Senior/Staff) Platform Engineer
description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI and Goldman Sachs.

Duna's infrastructure is part of the product. Enterprise customers buy our reliability, security posture and auditability, not just our features.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE

- Own and evolve our cloud platform: AWS, Kubernetes, networking, Terraform, CI/CD and observability

- Shape how our engineers build and ship, from local setups and preview environments to deploys, so the safe path is also the fast one

- Lead incidents calmly, find the root cause and make sure the fix holds

- Turn recurring manual work into automation and self-service tools that engineers actually use

- Help the team run AI agents in engineering safely, with the sandboxes and guardrails that make it possible

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Senior experience as a platform, DevOps, site reliability, infrastructure or cloud engineer. The title matters less than what you have built and run

- Depth in cloud infrastructure: Kubernetes, networking and infrastructure as code in production

- Experience improving developer experience is a strong plus, and an interest in security or observability is a welcome extra

- Time at a startup or scale-up, where you owned problems from start to finish

- Confidence to make calls, explain them clearly and push back when something looks wrong

- Curiosity across clouds and tools. We care more about how quickly you learn than which provider you know best

- Experience in regulated environments such as fintech, payments or identity is a plus

Our platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes with Terraform, Postgres and RabbitMQ, alongside a Node.js and TypeScript product stack built on event sourcing. You will not have used all of it before. We care more about the depth you bring and how you pick up the rest.

A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company.

We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application!

Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently.

I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live.

The first project you'd pick up with me is one I'm particularly excited about: evolving our brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product. After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook.

Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. You'll have a real say in our creative direction, and as the team grows, there's room for you to grow with it.

What you'll do:

- Evolve our brand identity and translate it into a distinctive, coherent visual language across our website, campaigns and marketing materials

- Design and improve our marketing website and landing pages, from early concepts and layouts to responsive designs, and build and maintain pages yourself

- Develop creative concepts for campaigns and product launches, and carry them through to ads, social, ebooks, brochures, presentations and event materials

- Create hero and product visuals that make a complex product clear and compelling

- Make our website clearer, more engaging and easier to navigate, with an eye on accessibility and conversion

- Build reusable components, templates and guidelines so colleagues can create on-brand materials themselves

- Bring structure to how design work gets requested, briefed, reviewed and delivered, and find ways for AI and automation to take repetitive work off the team's plate

- Brief and work with external specialists in development, motion, video or illustration when a project needs extra expertise

What you bring:

- You have around 3–5 years of experience as a brand or marketing designer, ideally at a B2B tech or SaaS company, or at an agency working with B2B clients

- Your portfolio shows real breadth in B2B marketing design: landing pages, ads, brochures, ebooks, hero visuals and product visuals. You know how to make a complex product easy to understand and good to look at

- Website work is a regular part of your job, not an occasional task. You've designed and built marketing pages yourself and can explain what you owned. You work in Webflow, our platform, or in something comparable like Framer and are happy to switch

- You think in concepts, not just layouts, and you have a strong eye for typography, composition and hierarchy

- You can take a project from a fuzzy brief to delivery without someone managing it for you, and you keep a clear head about priorities when several people need something from you at once

- You understand what design needs to do for marketing, and you can explain your choices to non-designers in a way that brings them along

- You look for ways to work smarter, whether that's a template, a component or an AI workflow that saves the team hours

- You're confident in Figma and communicate well in English

- You live within commuting distance of Amsterdam and are available 38 hours per week, with at least 2 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

- 25 paid holidays per year

- Hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite)

- A day off for your birthday

- Advantageous pension scheme

- 3 days of volunteering leave per year

- €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

- Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

- Free access to our office gym

- Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp

Compensation: €65K – €70K

title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

- Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

- Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

- Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

- Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

- Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

- Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

- Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

- Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

- Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

- Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

- Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

- Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

- Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

- Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

For open applications (where you don't see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

title: Senior Manager, Global Access
description:
About myTomorrows

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all external vendors collaborating with myTomorrows within the Global Access function.

- Support procurement efforts during vendor RFP processes, including requirements scoping, proposal evaluation, selection, and contracting.

- Collaborate with the quality and legal team during vendor onboarding and ongoing maintenance, ensuring all documentation, SOPs, and compliance records are accurate and up to date.

- Conduct structured regular check-ins with vendors to monitor performance, track program milestones, and resolve operational issues in a timely manner.

- Support procurement effort during annual vendor reviews

Partner Sourcing & Network Expansion

- Proactively identify and engage new global partners to expand myTomorrows' reach across both free-of-charge and paid expanded access programs.

- Develop and maintain a pipeline of potential partners across key geographic markets, with attention to regulatory and operational feasibility.

- Support the partnership terms negotiation and agreements in alignment with internal legal and compliance requirements.

EAP Operations Support

- Collaborate closely with the Operations team to support the delivery of paid EAP programs, contributing subject matter expertise throughout the program lifecycle.

- Apply proven strategies to accelerate reimbursement timelines and identify funding opportunities that support program sustainability and growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Legal, Finance, Regulatory, and Operations stakeholders to ensure vendor and partner activities remain compliant and aligned with organizational objectives.

- Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of internal processes, frameworks, and tools related to vendor governance and access program management.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Healthcare Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with solid experience in (paid) Expanded Access Programs or early access/compassionate use programs.

- Demonstrated experience managing external vendor and partner relationships at a global scale, including RFP processes, contracting, and performance oversight.

- Hands-on experience with reimbursement pathways and funding mechanisms, preferably in oncology, rare diseases, or specialty therapeutics.

Skills & Competencies

- Strong vendor governance skills, including the ability to manage complex multi-vendor environments across multiple geographies.

- Solid understanding of global regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to (paid) expanded access programs.

- Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with external partners and internal teams.

- High degree of organizational capability, with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

- Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

- Deep knowledge of the regulatory landscape governing (paid) expanded access and compassionate use programs across key markets (e.g., EU, US, APAC).

- Experience negotiating with payers, including familiarity with reimbursement frameworks, funding discussions, and access-related pricing considerations.

- Proven experience sourcing and scaling partner networks across multiple international markets.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Process Safety Lead
description:
About the role

As SkyNRG grows, we are looking for a Process Safety Lead to build and embed our corporate Process Safety Management framework.

In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Working across Engineering, Projects, Operations and HSE, you will combine technical expertise with functional leadership to strengthen process safety across the organization.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Develop and implement SkyNRG’s corporate Process Safety Management (PSM) framework as part of the Integrated Management System.

- Establish and embed process safety standards and procedures across current and future projects, including construction, commissioning, start-up and operations.

- Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits.

- Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC).

- Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance.

- Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets.

- Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to turn complex regulatory and risk-management requirements into practical standards. Structured and strategic in your approach, you are also willing to work hands-on to move implementation forward. You communicate clearly, make risk-based decisions, and can influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

You recognize yourself in the following:

- A master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Process Safety, or a closely related technical discipline.

- At least five years of relevant process safety experience within oil and gas, renewable fuels, chemicals, or another major hazard environment.

- Practical knowledge of SEVESO III requirements and their application within Major Accident Hazard facilities.

- Demonstrated experience developing or implementing Process Safety Management frameworks, Integrated Management Systems, or corporate process safety standards.

- Strong technical expertise in HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, Management of Change, Mechanical Integrity, contractor management, and commissioning or start-up activities.

- Experience assessing, governing, or assuring hazard studies across projects or operational environments.

- A proven ability to design and deliver process safety training for multidisciplinary audiences.

- Strong incident investigation skills, with the ability to translate findings into organizational learning and sustainable improvements.

- The ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance, and site leadership.

- Professional fluency in English.

- Experience with digital risk-assessment or barrier-management tools would be an advantage. A recognized qualification such as MoSHE, NEBOSH Process Safety, or an equivalent certification is also beneficial. Direct experience engaging with regulators or contributing to SEVESO Safety Reports would make your profile particularly relevant.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

- An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

- Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

- A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

raw.title: Process Safety Lead
raw.description:
About the role

As SkyNRG grows, we are looking for a Process Safety Lead to build and embed our corporate Process Safety Management framework.

In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Working across Engineering, Projects, Operations and HSE, you will combine technical expertise with functional leadership to strengthen process safety across the organization.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and implement SkyNRG’s corporate Process Safety Management (PSM) framework as part of the Integrated Management System.

  • Establish and embed process safety standards and procedures across current and future projects, including construction, commissioning, start-up and operations.

  • Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits.

  • Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC).

  • Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance.

  • Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets.

  • Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to turn complex regulatory and risk-management requirements into practical standards. Structured and strategic in your approach, you are also willing to work hands-on to move implementation forward. You communicate clearly, make risk-based decisions, and can influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • A master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Process Safety, or a closely related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of relevant process safety experience within oil and gas, renewable fuels, chemicals, or another major hazard environment.

  • Practical knowledge of SEVESO III requirements and their application within Major Accident Hazard facilities.

  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing Process Safety Management frameworks, Integrated Management Systems, or corporate process safety standards.

  • Strong technical expertise in HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, Management of Change, Mechanical Integrity, contractor management, and commissioning or start-up activities.

  • Experience assessing, governing, or assuring hazard studies across projects or operational environments.

  • A proven ability to design and deliver process safety training for multidisciplinary audiences.

  • Strong incident investigation skills, with the ability to translate findings into organizational learning and sustainable improvements.

  • The ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance, and site leadership.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Experience with digital risk-assessment or barrier-management tools would be an advantage. A recognized qualification such as MoSHE, NEBOSH Process Safety, or an equivalent certification is also beneficial. Direct experience engaging with regulators or contributing to SEVESO Safety Reports would make your profile particularly relevant.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Bij i3D.net bouwen we aan de toekomst van gaming en netwerktechnologie. Met een van de meest verbonden netwerken ter wereld bieden we internationale infrastructuuroplossingen voor miljoenen gebruikers. We combineren minimale vertraging, betrouwbare verbindingen en schaalbaarheid met persoonlijke ondersteuning en maatwerk. Zo helpen we gameontwikkelaars en bedrijven zoals NVIDIA, DuckDuckGo en Ubisoft om wereldwijd te groeien.

Ons Finance-team zorgt ervoor dat onze groeiende internationale organisatie ook financieel op rolletjes loopt. Daarom zoeken we een nauwkeurige, betrokken en proactieve Financieel Administratief Medewerker met een focus op Accounts Payable.

Jouw rol

Samen met je collega’s verzorg je de dagelijkse financiële administratie, met jouw focus op het crediteurenproces. Je zorgt dat inkoopfacturen correct worden verwerkt, tijdig worden goedgekeurd en volgens afspraak worden betaald.

Je bent een zichtbaar en toegankelijk aanspreekpunt binnen de organisatie. Je zoekt actief contact met collega’s, bewaakt de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en volgt openstaande acties proactief op. Bij afwijkingen zoek je uit wat er speelt en werk je samen met leveranciers en collega’s aan een oplossing.

Daarnaast onderhoud je de workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, het factuurverwerkingssysteem. Daarmee help je het factuurverwerkingsproces efficiënt en overzichtelijk te houden.

Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van acht collega’s en rapporteert aan de Finance Manager.

Wat je gaat doen

- Controleren en boeken van inkoopfacturen op de juiste grootboekrekening en kostenplaats, met toepassing van de juiste btw-code.

- Controleren of facturen aansluiten op contractuele afspraken en, waar van toepassing, inkooporders.

- Bewaken van de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en proactief opvolgen van openstaande acties bij collega’s.

- Uitzoeken en oplossen van afwijkende, geblokkeerde of onvolledige facturen.

- Onderhouden van workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, in afstemming met de verantwoordelijke collega’s.

- Voorbereiden van betaalvoorstellen en verwerken van betalingen volgens de interne autorisatieprocedure.

- Verwerken van bankmutaties die betrekking hebben op leveranciersbetalingen.

- Bijhouden en controleren van leveranciersgegevens volgens de afgesproken procedures.

- Onderhouden van leverancierscontact over facturen, betalingen en openstaande vragen.

- Controleren en afstemmen van openstaande crediteurenposten.

- Ondersteunen bij de maand- en jaarafsluiting, onder meer door ontbrekende facturen en nog te verwerken kosten te signaleren.

- Zorgen voor een volledige en controleerbare digitale administratie.

- Signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over verbeteringen in de financiële processen en systemen.

Hoe succes in het eerste jaar eruitziet

Je kent onze financiële processen en systemen en voert je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Facturen worden correct verwerkt en tijdig ter goedkeuring en betaling aangeboden. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande posten en acties en schakelt tijdig wanneer de voortgang dreigt vast te lopen.

Collega’s weten je te vinden en jij weet wie je moet benaderen om zaken verder te brengen. De workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee zijn actueel en je hebt bijgedragen aan een efficiënter factuurverwerkingsproces.

Tijdens de maand- en jaarafsluiting lever je de benodigde informatie tijdig en zorgvuldig aan.

Wie jij bent

- Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en wacht niet af wanneer iets blijft liggen. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, duidelijke manier aan op openstaande acties.

- Je bent nieuwsgierig, leert graag en denkt mee over hoe processen beter kunnen. Een internationale technische omgeving spreekt je aan en je vindt het leuk om vanuit Finance bij te dragen aan een organisatie in de wereld van gaming, infrastructuur en hosting.

- Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding in een financiële richting en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare financiële administratieve functie, bij voorkeur binnen de crediteurenadministratie.

- Ervaring met verschillende btw-codes en het correct toepassen daarvan bij de verwerking van inkoopfacturen.

- Praktische kennis van Excel en affiniteit met financiële systemen en digitale factuurverwerking.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels voor contact met collega’s en internationale leveranciers.

- Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 24 uur per week, met ten minste twee vaste dagen op kantoor in Rotterdam.

- Ervaring met NetSuite en 4cee is een pré.

Waarom werken bij i3D.net?

- Maak het verschil:

- Draag bij aan een solide financiële basis voor een internationaal bedrijf met een jarenlange staat van dienst.

- Hybride werken

- Profiteer van flexibel hybride werken, een thuiswerkbudget en hoogwaardige hulpmiddelen.

- Ruimte om te groeien

- Ontwikkel je verder met een vergoeding voor opleidingen, loopbaanbegeleiding en mogelijkheden om je kennis en vaardigheden uit te breiden.

- Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden

- Een marktconform salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus, 25 vakantiedagen naast de officiële feestdagen, een reiskostenvergoeding en een premievrije pensioenregeling.

- Blijf in beweging

- Maak gratis gebruik van onze eigen fitnessruimte in Rotterdam.

- Gratis games

- Krijg toegang tot de gamebibliotheek van Ubisoft

title: Creative Director
description:
Creative Director

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As Creative Director, you lead and evolve Mollie's Brand Design function. You help define and drive our global brand design vision, keeping it consistent and excellent across every channel and market. You support the creative vision and execution of our brand across every touchpoint, from campaigns and product experiences to storytelling and motion. The job is to balance craft excellence with speed and scale.

Brand Design is a core enabler of our GTM and growth. You'll build a consistent, world-class brand experience across our platforms and markets, so the businesses we serve understand and choose Mollie. Your creative will power GTM and growth across Europe. We're a European business today, and going global is on our roadmap. You'll own the evolution of our visual identity, design systems and creative principles, and act as the quality bar for all brand output, with executive backing to shape how Mollie shows up everywhere, including as we expand.

You'll lead an in-house studio of around 5 to 8 designers across brand, motion, digital and campaign, and build a culture of craft, feedback and continuous improvement. You'll partner directly with marketing leadership, product, growth and our founder to turn strategy into insight-driven creative. You'll work with Marketing Operations on workflows and tooling, and bring in AI tools to speed up ideation, production and iteration without lowering the bar. You'll also collaborate with teams like Employee Experience and Internal Events, and manage external agencies, freelancers and production partners when needed.

What you'll ship

- A clear, evolved brand design vision, plus a refreshed visual identity and design system that markets adopt consistently.

- A high-performing, well-structured in-house studio, with the workflows, tooling and modular systems to deliver high-quality output at scale.

- Impactful end to end creative for flagship campaigns, product launches and brand moments that is on-brand, insight-driven and effective.

- AI-enabled creative workflows that measurably increase speed and output while holding the quality bar.

- Strong creative partnership with Marketing, Product, Growth and leadership, including a meaningful uplift to performance marketing creative.

- In your first 90 days: an assessment of the team, output and brand system, a defined vision and quick wins delivered.

- Within 6 to 12 months: a scaled studio operating model, the evolved identity live in market and AI workflows embedded.

What you'll bring

- Proven experience leading and scaling in-house design teams or creative studios, including people leadership of a multidisciplinary team. You inspire, challenge and develop designers at all levels.

- A strong portfolio that shows high-quality brand, campaign and digital work, backed by proven brand craft.

- Exceptional creative judgement and taste, and a clear point of view on what "great" looks like.

- Experience building and maintaining design systems and brand frameworks that scale for consistency and self-serve.

- Operational strength in planning, prioritization, resourcing and workflow design, so quality holds at scale.

- Hands-on experience applying AI in creative workflows, including concepting, production and scaling assets.

- Strong communication and storytelling, with the ability to explain creative decisions to senior stakeholders, and fluent English.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Privacy & AI Officer
description:
Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland!

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

- Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

- Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

- Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

- Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

- Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

- Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

Wat ga je doen

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

- Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

- Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

- Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen.

- Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

- Je werkt nauw samen met de 2e lijn Risk & Compliance

Wat wij bieden

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

- Een brutosalaris tussen de € 3.859 en € 5.358 per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

- Een contract van 1 jaar met de intentie voor een vaste aanstelling.

- Een 13e maand, bedrijfsfitnessregeling, fietsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling.

- 25 vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.

- Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een betrouwbare organisatie.

- Uitstekende werksfeer; plezier in je werk staat bij ons voorop.

- Aantrekkelijke kortingen op onze verzekeringsproducten en diensten.

Wie wij zijn

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

  • Organiseren van bijeenkomsten zoals diploma-uitreikingen, kick-offs en trainingsdagen.

Jij krijgt energie van organiseren, plannen en samenwerken. Daarnaast denk je graag creatief mee en zie je kansen om processen slimmer en beter in te richten.

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding richting HR, Learning & Development of vergelijkbaar;

  • Je bent op zoek naar een fulltime meewerkstage;

  • Je hebt interesse in leren en ontwikkelen;

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afwisselende en leerzame meewerkstage;

  • Een betrokken team binnen een dynamische organisatie in de automotive branche;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Een stageplek op het hoofdkantoor van Van Mossel in Waalwijk.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description:
Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk.

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

- Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

- Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

- Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

- Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

- KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

- Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

- Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.

Wat breng je mee?

- Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

- Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

- Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

- Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

- Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is

- Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

- Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

- Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

- Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

- AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

- adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

- €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

  • Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

  • Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Utilities
raw.description:
Jij vertaalt complexe vraagstukken in energie en infrastructuur naar AI die echt wordt gebruikt.

Van netcongestie en aansluitaanvragen tot inspecties en klantprocessen: utilities werken met complexe systemen, grote hoeveelheden informatie en hoge eisen aan betrouwbaarheid.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je dicht op de operatie van de klant. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI voor processen die moeten blijven draaien

Je kent de praktijk van energiebedrijven, netbeheerders of andere utilities: technische assets, werkorders, klantvragen, datastromen en de afstemming tussen operationele en IT-systemen. Denk aan:

  • Aansluitaanvragen sneller verwerken in tijden van netcongestie, met AI die de informatie ordent en medewerkers helpt bij de beoordeling.

  • Klantcontact over contracten en jaarafrekeningen.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.
