title: Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)

Building a finance function from zero is rare — doing it at a fast-growing robotics AI company is rarer. Sereact is scaling internationally (Germany, US, Switzerland), and our Director Accounting is looking for a smart early hire to build our finance function together: processes, systems, and standards, from day one. You'll work directly with leadership and help take the group through its first statutory audit. Based on-site at our Stuttgart headquarters.

Who We Are

Sereact builds AI that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world — in warehouses and factories. Our mission is to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold people who want to make a real difference.

Overview

Working side by side with our Director Accounting, you'll help bring bookkeeping in-house, help shape our finance systems setup (including how we use Odoo alongside DATEV), and get us ready for our first statutory audit — working closely with the founders and our external tax and audit partners. We value people who work independently, take initiative, and build rather than wait for the perfect setup.

Your Responsibilities

- Day-to-day accounting: Own the books (general and sub-ledgers) and gradually bring bookkeeping in-house from our external provider.

- Payments & working capital: Run accounts payable, accounts receivable, and the payment process.

- Closing & audit: Prepare monthly and quarterly closes under HGB and support the annual financial statements, including our first-ever statutory audit.

- Systems: Help shape our finance systems and decide the target setup — whether Odoo replaces DATEV or runs first as a subledger alongside it.

- Partners: Be the day-to-day counterpart to our tax advisors and auditors.

- Process & automation: Build our finance processes and first automations hand in hand with our Director Accounting, including group-wide topics around our US and CH entities.

Qualifications

- A degree (business, finance, or a related field) is preferred — but above all we're looking for smart, analytical people who learn fast. Solid HGB fundamentals and hands-on DATEV (or comparable) experience matter more to us than a specific certificate.

- Experience with monthly and annual closes; IFRS knowledge is a plus.

- A hands-on, builder mindset — you like building from scratch and don't wait for finished processes or a team. No need for a perfect résumé.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and fast change and structure things yourself — pragmatic over perfectionist, but with a clear sense of when rigor matters (closing, audit).

- Tool- and automation-savvy; you use modern tools and AI as a matter of course (Odoo or ERP experience is a plus).

- Fluent German and good English.

Our Interview Plan

- Application: Apply via our careers page with your CV — a few lines on why this role interests you are welcome.

- Technical fit interview, including a live case study (40 min): A deeper dive into your accounting know-how and problem-solving approach. Together we'll work through a short, role-relevant case — no prep needed, we're interested in how you think.

- Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you're looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

- On-site visit in Stuttgart, including a founder interview: Meet the team in our office, talk with one of our founders, and get a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer

- Real ownership: build the finance function from scratch together with our Director Accounting, with direct exposure to the founders.

- Grow with the function: as Sereact scales, your scope and responsibilities grow with it.

- Wellpass (gym membership)

- Flexible working hours

- Home office when you need it

- A motivated team and an open company culture

- Competitive compensation

Sounds like you? We'd love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive GCC to join our Sales team in UAE.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and you'll have the backing of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

- Build a territory plan that identifies land opportunities and expand possibilities, leveraging extended resources like partners, marketing, and customer success.

- Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

- Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

- Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

- Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

- Manage pipeline and forecast with discipline and accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

- Must have proven product sales experience in Oman, Qatar

- Must have proven experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation.

- Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

- Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

- Developing territory and account planning instincts, with the ability to orchestrate resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you.

- Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

- Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

- A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #MEAREGION

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

- United States: $244,600.00 to $394,400.00

- United Kingdom: £153,600.00 to £252,600.00

- Singapore: S$303,800.00 to S$455,700.00

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

- Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

- In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

title: Steuerberater (m/w/d) in Hanover, auf Wunsch mit Partnerperspektive, gesucht - mindestens 90.000€
description:
TaxTalente ist die Nr. 1 Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende in der Steuerberatung.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Hanover

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

- Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
- Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
- Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
- Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
- Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
- Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

- Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
- Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
- Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
- Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

- Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
- Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
- Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
- Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
- Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
- Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

- Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
- Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
- 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
- Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
- Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

title: (Senior) Operations Manager – Abrechnung Pflegekassen Health Tech (w/m/x) - German-speaking
description:
Über Patronus

Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Mehr als 25.000 Menschen verlassen sich bereits auf uns. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Als (Senior) Operations Manager – Abrechnung Pflegekassen Health Tech (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Partner & Payments Management Teams (aktuell 5 Personen) und berichtest direkt an unsere Senior Team Lead Partner & Payments Management. Wenn Pflegekassen die Kosten für die Patronus-Uhr übernehmen, steckt dahinter ein komplexer Prozess: vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme über die Bestätigung und die Abrechnung bis zum Zahlungseingang. Genau diesen geschäftskritischen Prozess verantwortest du – mit direktem Einfluss auf unseren Cashflow.

Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist. Wenn es dir genauso geht, bist du bei uns richtig!

Deine Mission

- Du verantwortest die Abrechnung mit Pflegekassen End-to-End – vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme bis zum Zahlungseingang – und packst dabei selbst operativ mit an.

- Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis.

- Du prüfst Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und finanzielle Risiken früh und machst Zahlen und Prozesse mit einem aussagekräftigen Reporting transparent.

- Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind.

- Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie sich unsere Abrechnung in Zukunft aufstellt – nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch in der Umsetzung.

Dein Talent

- Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld.

- Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert.

- Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern.

- Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Plus:

- Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen

- Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Zapier, n8n) oder SQL-Grundkenntnisse

Unser Angebot

⚖️ Fair von Anfang an: Du bekommst von uns direkt unser bestmögliches Angebot – wir gehen von Anfang an mit der Zahl rein, die woanders erst am Ende einer Verhandlung steht.

🏢 Arbeitsort: 2 Tage pro Woche mobil arbeiten sowie klimatisiertes Büro mit Spree-Blick mitten in Friedrichshain

📚 Wachstum: 500€ jährliches Learning & Development-Budget, klarer Career Framework und 360°-Feedback für deine Weiterentwicklung

🤝 Miteinander: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam bei regelmäßigen Company Events und bei vierteljährlichen Teamevents mit 50€ Budget pro Person für besondere Erlebnisse (z.B. Escape Rooms, Cooking Classes oder Game Shows)

🏖️ Urlaub: Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub (nach Start mit 26 im 1. & 28 im 2. Jahr)

🧘 Fitness & Freizeit: Bis zu 50% Rabatt auf Urban Sports Club, Corporate Benefits, Restaurant-Deals sowie Family & Friends Coupon auf die Patronus Uhr

🚲 Mobilität: 30% Rabatt aufs Job Ticket sowie vergünstigtes Fahrrad-Leasing

🥤 Verpflegung: Kostenfreie Softdrinks & Kaffeevollautomat, Müslibar, vierteljährliche Company Brunches sowie wöchentliche Healthy Snacks

💻 Hardware: Freie Wahl zwischen MacBook und Lenovo

🌍 Impact: Ein Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert plus ein Volunteering-Tag im Jahr

Einfach. Sicher. Leben. Mit Patronus.

Wir sind mehr als ein Anbieter für intelligente Notruf-Uhren – wir entwickeln Technologien, die Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes Leben ermöglichen: We create a world where aging is delightful.

Möglich macht das unsere revolutionäre Patronus-Uhr: Auf den ersten Blick nicht als Notruf erkennbar, ermöglicht sie es Nutzer*innen, jederzeit und überall unkompliziert Hilfe zu rufen. Damit sorgen wir für Sicherheit und retten im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes Leben. Sie ist dabei unser Türöffner, um das Leben älterer Menschen, ihrer Angehörigen und Pflegepersonen zu verbessern und das Gesundheitssystem effektiver zu machen. Damit in Zukunft alle Menschen ihr Leben so leben können, wie sie es möchten.

Klingt nach einer perfekten Stelle für dich?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Auch wenn du unserem Anforderungsprofil nicht zu 100 % entsprichst, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich bei uns zu bewerben.

Patronus ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt fördert. Wir bemühen uns, ein freundliches, sicheres und einladendes Umfeld für alle unsere Mitarbeiter*innen zu schaffen, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Einschränkungen und Begabungen jeglicher Art, körperlicher Erscheinung, sozialem Hintergrund, Familienstand, Alter oder Religion (oder deren Fehlen).

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • Strong grasp of pipeline orchestration, testing frameworks and the practices that keep them healthy at scale.

  • Comfortable setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and working closely with finance, payments and audit stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off clearly and influence the decision that follows.

  • You use AI hands-on in your day-to-day technical work and can show specific examples of how it has changed the way you build, review or debug data models.

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Regional Director of Sales
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

As our Regional Director of Enterprise Sales, you act as the primary catalyst for RobCo's enterprise growth across the German market, driving large-scale industrial adoption of our Autonomous Manufacturing Platform. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up.

Your Responsibilities

- Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets.

- Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises.

- Champion Technical Solutions: Direct complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles by clearly communicating the strategic, financial, and technical ROI of RobCo's modular robotics and physical AI solutions.

- Scale Enterprise Footprint: Identify and unlock new market verticals and geographic opportunities across the DACH region to continually expand the sales pipeline.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering and Product teams to align client requirements with product capabilities and deliver seamless rollouts.

- Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene, actionable sales reporting, and highly accurate quarterly/annual revenue forecasts in Salesforce.

- Represent the Brand: Position RobCo as the premier AI-driven automation provider through representation at key industry events, panel discussions, and executive roundtables.

- Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management.

We're looking for someone who has:

- Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience.

- Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.

- Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors.

- Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles.

- Deep understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models.

- Willingness to travel up to 50-75% within Germany for client meetings, trade shows, onsite evaluations, and international team offsites.

- Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high drive for results, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

Why join RobCo?

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

- Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Recruiter, Commercial
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Your mission

Our market moves fast, and so do we. As our business continues to scale, we're looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Commercial Recruiter to take ownership of hiring across the DACH region.

You'll be the driving force behind building our commercial powerhouse — attracting and securing exceptional talent across Sales, Account Management and Business Development.

From the initial hiring kick-off to the final signed contract, you'll own the entire recruitment journey. You'll partner closely with business leaders, shape hiring strategies, identify outstanding talent and turn ambitious growth plans into reality.

This isn't just about filling vacancies. It's about building the people, teams and capabilities that will define our next chapter.

If you love moving fast, building relationships and making great hires happen, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

- Own the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close.

- Hunt passive talent via LinkedIn, referrals, events and direct approach.

- Interview in German and English and deliver sharp shortlists, fast.

- Close: negotiate offers, beat counter-offers, keep candidates warm until day one.

- Advise hiring managers on market, salaries and timelines, and push for quick decisions.

- Track everything in Ashby and report on pipeline and time-to-hire.

You'll thrive here if you have

- Drive and ownership. Every open role is yours until it's signed.

- Curiosity. You test new channels, tools and outreach, and keep what works.

- Hunger to learn. You want to grow fast with a scale-up where things change weekly.

What you bring

- Fluent German (C1 or native) and strong English

- Experience in recruiting (agency or in-house), ideally commercial or sales roles

- Proven direct sourcing and closing skills

- Bonus: start-up or scale-up experience, an energy or B2B background, Ashby know-how.

Why Andercore

- Impact: your hires directly drive our growth

- Growth: steep learning curve, close to leadership, and a scope that grows with you.

- Team: driven, international, and we celebrate wins together.

Hiring process

Intro call → Hiring manager interview → Case study → Meet the team → Offer

Ready to Hunt?

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.

What we're looking for

- High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

- You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.

- The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

- Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

title: Head of Operations
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The Role

The Head of Operations reports to Sauraj (Co-CEO, GTM and Operations) and take ownership of operational excellence company-wide. As Finance, Legal, People, IT and InfoSec, and Compliance grow into their own functions, this person partners with each lead on the operational side of their work and holds the whole together as one system. They lead the operations team and grow it into one fit for a company many times our current size.

- Builds the operating engine for growth and scale. Owns how the company runs operationally and designs the processes that hold up as headcount, revenue, and complexity grow fast. Everything breaks at each new stage of growth; this person sees it coming and rebuilds ahead of the curve so operations never becomes the ceiling on how fast we can move.

- Drives operational excellence across every function. Accountable for the operational side of finance, people, legal, and the wider back office, with IT, InfoSec, and compliance covered through the relevant leads. You will set the standard and makes sure nothing important falls between functions.

- Brings order to ambiguity. Takes the most complex, cross-functional problems and drives them to resolution bringing all the right stakeholder to the table, motivating and inspiring them to come together and deliver the project for everyone’s benefit.

- Is a decision partner. Frames trade-offs, surfaces risk early, and turns decisions into action, so the leadership team works from reliable data and sound judgment.

- Builds and inspires the operations team. Hires, develops, and leads an operations team people want to be part of, and sets a standard of execution that raises the bar for everyone who works with them.

Who we're looking for

Essential:

- High-growth experience above all. Has operated inside a company through rapid scaling, seen what breaks at each stage, and built the processes and structures that scaled through it. This is the most important thing we are looking for.

- Global operating experience. Has run operations across multiple countries and regions, comfortable holding a company together across time zones and jurisdictions, not just in a single market.

- Broad operations ownership. Has driven operational excellence across two or more of finance, people, legal, and business operations as a senior generalist, partnering with specialist leads rather than owning their decisions.

- A leader operators want to follow. Builds and develops strong teams and is the kind of person other excellent operators want to come and work with.

A big plus:

- Experience in the data, developer tools, or AI market, and comfort working credibly with a technical, research-led team

- Has built an operations function that grew with a company from startup into real scale

What makes someone thrive here:

- Energized by building the systems that unlock the next stage of growth, not by maintaining the status quo

- Radical ownership: runs at the most difficult problems and resolves them rather than passing them up

- Practical and pragmatic: builds processes that scale without bloat, using as much structure as the moment needs

- Calm and decisive under ambiguity and competing priorities, and sets that standard for the team

Location

Ideally this person will be located at one of our hubs in New York or Berlin. In exceptional circumstances, we will be able to consider remote/hybrid applications.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Als SAP & Prozessberater im Supply Chain & Manufacturing realisieren wir mit unseren Kunden eine gemeinsame Vision: Eine wettbewerbsfähige, intelligente und resiliente Supply Chain, die den Champions der Fertigungsindustrie nachhaltiges Wachstum in einem unsicheren Umfeld ermöglicht.

Unsere SSCM Practice verbindet strategische Business Beratung mit tiefgreifender Umsetzungskompetenz in der IT - von der Strategie über den Produktentstehungsprozess (PLM), Produktion (PP / PS, DM, MES, PM), Lager (WM), Qualität (QM) und Beschaffung (MM) bis hin zu Vertrieb, Zollabwicklung und Service (SD, GTS, CX. S/4 Service). Durch umfassende Value Stream Kompetenzen von Design to Operate erzeugen wir kontinuierlichen Business Value – Strategy to Execution!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir erfahrene SAP S/4HANA Logistik Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich Vertrieb (SAP SD).

Was dich erwartet

- Lösungsorientierte Prozessberatung großer Industrieunternehmen mit einem Schwerpunkt in der produzierenden Industrie

- Konzeption, Design und Implementierung von Unternehmenslösungen im Bereich SAP Logistik

- Übernahme von Modulverantwortung im Bereich SD in nationalen und internationalen SAP Projekten

- Change Management & Coaching

- Unterstützung im Presales und beim Auf- und Ausbau unserer Kundenbeziehungen

- Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen

- Mentoring von Trainees und angehenden Senior Consultants

Was wir uns wünschen

- Erstklassiger Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Maschinenbau, Logistik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung als SAP Logistikberater mit dem Schwerpunkt SAP SD in Prozess- und Optimierungsprojekten im Bereich Logistik

- Idealerweise modulübergreifende Integrationskenntnisse im Bereich Logistik

- Erste Erfahrungen als Projektleiter von fachbereichsnahen SAP Beratern oder als Teilprojektleiter in großen SAP Projekten von Vorteil

- Selbstständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, analytische und konzeptionelle Denkweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Ebene des Teams und der Abteilungsleitung in multikulturellen Umgebungen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

- Reisebereitschaft, auch für gelegentliche Auslandseinsätze

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, diverse Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, Yoga etc.

title: Senior Group Accountant (m/f/d)
description:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

- Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

- Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

- Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

- Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

- Attractive salary and social benefits

- Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

- 30+1 vacation days plus special leave

- Training and development opportunities

- Company pension plan and employee insurance

- Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)

- Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces

- Bicycle and IT leasing

- Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket

- Employee discounts via Benify

Your tasks: 📌

- Manage and coordinate the Group’s periodic consolidation processes in LucaNet, including intercompany reconciliation, consolidation entries and quality reviews.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual Group reporting and consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS.

- Act as a key contact for IFRS and Group Accounting matters, including technical assessments, accounting policies and reporting guidelines.

- Monitor new IFRS requirements and ensure their consistent implementation across the Group.

- Continuously improve Group Accounting, consolidation and reporting processes, including related systems and documentation.

- Collaborate with international finance teams and corporate functions and serve as a key contact for external auditors.

- Support cross-functional Finance projects, management reporting and selected capital-market and strategic Finance initiatives.

Your profile: 🔎

- University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or a comparable field.

- Several years of relevant experience in Group Accounting, consolidation, financial reporting or audit, ideally gained with a Big Four/international audit firm and/or an international company.

- Strong practical knowledge of IFRS and experience with consolidated financial statements.

- Hands-on experience with LucaNet or a comparable consolidation and reporting system.

- Strong analytical and project management skills with a structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

- Confident communicator, comfortable working with senior management, auditors and international stakeholders.

- High level of ownership, reliability and integrity.

- Very good Excel and PowerPoint skills and fluent English; German is an advantage.

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:

https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/

ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about shaping the future of lottery experiences.

LOTTO24 is Germany’s leading online provider of state-licensed lottery products, offering customers convenient and secure access to popular games like LOTTO 6aus49, Eurojackpot, and GlücksSpirale. As a trusted partner of the state lotteries, LOTTO24 ensures that every ticket sold helps support charitable, social, and community projects across Germany. By combining ease of play, trusted security, and meaningful social contributions, LOTTO24 exemplifies ZEAL’s vision of making lottery participation more accessible while giving back to society.

The role:

As our Brand Manager, you bring our brand and marketing strategy to life through impactful consumer campaigns and creative initiatives. You translate strategic direction and campaign concepts into high-quality execution across relevant channels and customer touchpoints. Working closely with cross-functional teams, agencies, and external partners, you combine creativity, strong execution, and data-driven decision-making to strengthen our brand and contribute to measurable business impact.

Your tasks:

• Translate strategic direction and campaign concepts into effective Brand Marketing activities

• Collaborate closely with Media, CRM, Creative and Product teams to ensure a consistent brand experience

• Execute integrated consumer campaigns across high-reach channels such as TV, online video and OOH

• Manage creative development and production with agencies, partners and our internal Creative Studio

• Use consumer and market insights to inform campaign execution and creative decisions

• Monitor campaign KPIs and optimize activities based on data, results and learnings

• Align marketing initiatives with Product, Legal and Compliance requirements

• Manage campaign and production budgets within defined frameworks

• Analyze campaign performance and derive clear learnings for future activities

What you offer us:

• Several years of in-house Brand Marketing experience for a consumer-facing brand

• Strong understanding of brand strategy, positioning and integrated consumer marketing

• Strong analytical mindset with experience using data, research and customer insights to drive Brand Marketing decisions

• Strong understanding of relevant Brand Marketing channels and their different roles

• Hands-on experience executing integrated B2C marketing campaigns

• Experience working with creative teams, agencies and content productions

• Strong project management and organizational skills

• Experience managing campaign or production budgets

• Experience with campaign analytics, reporting and marketing measurement

• Professional proficiency in German, both written and spoken

• Experience in Performance Marketing, CRM or evidence-based marketing is a plus

• Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer businesses is a plus

What we offer:

- A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

- A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

- Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

- Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

- Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

- Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

- Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

- Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

- Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

- Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

- Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

title: HR Generalist
description:
We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We’re looking for an HR Generalist who can support our team members and help ensure our HR processes run smoothly. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key HR functions, including benefits administration, payroll support, employment law compliance, and employee relations. You’ll serve as a trusted resource for team members, helping navigate HR-related questions while ensuring our policies and processes are consistent, compliant, and effective. As part of a small, growing company, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving our HR processes and helping create a positive team member experience.

This fully remote role reports to our Director of Operations, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

What You'll Do

- Serve as the primary HR point of contact for team members, answering questions and providing guidance on company policies and other employment-related matters

- Administer employee benefits in partnership with brokers and vendors, including open enrollment, qualifying life events, and resolving benefits-related issues

- Maintain accurate, confidential employee records in HR systems and assist the payroll team with payroll adjustments

- Manage HR compliance with federal and state employment laws, unemployment insurance, workers' compensation, accommodation requests, and leave administration, involving legal counsel when appropriate and making informed recommendations to leadership

- Stay current on federal and state employment laws and HR market trends

- Coordinate state registrations for our fully-remote organization across multiple jurisdictions, using our existing systems and vendors

- Review and update the employee handbook, HR policies, and internal documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance

- Handle day-to-day employee relations matters, supporting team members and managers in addressing workplace concerns, documenting issues and resolutions, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.

- Support performance management, compensation reviews, and employee engagement initiatives, including surveys and feedback analysis

- Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the overall team member experience

What You'll Bring

- 4+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR administration, or a related HR generalist role.

- Hands-on experience administering employee benefits, supporting payroll processes, and managing employee relations.

- Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws, including ADA, FMLA, workers' compensation, and multi-state HR compliance requirements.

- Experience supporting performance management processes, including performance reviews, talent assessments, and employee engagement initiatives.

- Proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms, such as Gusto, Rippling, or ADP, and experience administering performance management tools like Lattice.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities and handle sensitive information.

- An ability to model EngagedMD’s core values and action principles.

- Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to thrive in a small, fast-paced organization.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent career experience.

It's Also Nice If You…

- Have experience working in a SaaS, healthcare, or technology organization.

- Have successfully worked remotely with distributed teams in the past.

What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and equity

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage heavily subsidized by the company

- Open Paid Time Off

- Paid family and medical leave

- Generous paid holidays

- 401(k) retirement savings plan

EngagedMD is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe our company and products are made better by the varied perspectives of our employees, each of whom we seek to empower and support in their individuality. We hire our team members on the basis of merit, qualifications, and the needs of our business in order to best achieve our mission to make life easier for the clinics and patients we serve.

About EngagedMD

EngagedMD is a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We're a mission-driven, collaborative team that values bold thinking, meaningful results, and continuous improvement. We move quickly, work together, and empower our team members to make a real impact.

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektro
description:
Du kennst dich in der HKLS- oder Elektrotechnik aus, behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick und möchtest mehr Verantwortung übernehmen? Du hast Freude daran, technische und wirtschaftliche Herausforderungen zu lösen, Menschen zu koordinieren und gemeinsam mit einem Team erfolgreiche Projekte umzusetzen?

Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig.

Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Projektleiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektrotechnik, der technisches Know-how mit Organisationstalent, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Egal, ob du bereits Projekte leitest oder aus der Fachplanung, Bauleitung oder technischen Projektkoordination kommst und den nächsten Schritt in Richtung Führungsverantwortung gehen möchtest: Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu steuern, ein Team fachlich zu führen und dich persönlich wie fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aufgaben

- Du übernimmst die technische und organisatorische Verantwortung für spannende Projekte im Bereich HKLS oder Elektrotechnik.

- Du koordinierst und führst dein Projektteam fachlich, verteilst Aufgaben, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst für eine strukturierte und erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung.

- Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Projektpartner und interne Teams und stellst eine klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation sicher.

Qualifikation

- Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in mindestens einem dieser Fachbereiche mit – beispielsweise aus der Fachplanung, Ausführung, Bauleitung, Projektkoordination oder Projektabwicklung.

- Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis, kennst relevante Normen, Planungs- und Ausführungsabläufe und kannst technische Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen.

- Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig koordiniert werden müssen.

- Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und möchtest dein Team unterstützen, motivieren und gemeinsam gute Ergebnisse erreichen.

- Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

- Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Projekte im Bereich HKLS oder Elektrotechnik, bei denen du deine technische Erfahrung einbringen und echte Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum, eigenständigen Entscheidungen und der Möglichkeit, Projekte und Teams aktiv zu führen.

- Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Kommunikation und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kollegen, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

- Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, lösungsorientiertes Denken und neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Wir suchen nicht einfach jemanden, der Projekte verwaltet, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen, technische Herausforderungen lösen und gemeinsam mit einem Team etwas bewegen möchte.

Du musst nicht bereits alles können oder jahrelang als Projektleiter gearbeitet haben. Viel wichtiger sind uns deine technische Erfahrung, dein Organisationstalent, deine Eigeninitiative und deine Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wenn du Erfahrung in der Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektrotechnik mitbringst, gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Lust hast, Projekte aktiv zu gestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben ist nicht zwingend erforderlich. Wir freuen uns jedoch, wenn du uns einen kurzen Einblick in deine Beweggründe und deine Motivation gibst.

Bewirb dich ganz unkompliziert mit deinem Lebenslauf sowie, falls vorhanden, relevanten Projektbeispielen oder Zeugnissen.

title: Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning
description:
At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.

Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.

You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.

This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.

  • Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK.
    Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Own the simulator

  • Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.
  • Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.
  • Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.
  • Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.
  • Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.

Tune and close the sim2real gap

  • Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.
  • Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.
  • Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.
  • Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.
  • Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator

Grow into reinforcement learning

  • Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.
  • Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.
  • Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.
  • Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.
  • Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.
  • Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.

Qualifications

  • A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).
  • Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.
  • Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.
  • Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.
  • Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.

Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions.

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement
