title: Principal Consultant - Strategic Infrastructure Advisory
description:
About Infrata

Infrata, part of dss+, is a specialist infrastructure advisory business of around 100 people working with investors, lenders, owners, operators and governments across transport, aviation, maritime, energy, digital infrastructure and the energy transition.

Our reputation is built on technical and commercial due diligence: fast, rigorous, independent work on the assets and businesses our clients are buying, financing or operating. We are now building on that base to offer clients strategic advice across the full life of an asset, not only at the point of transaction.

Why this role

Infrata has strong technical expertise and established client relationships. We are looking for someone who can help us build on these strengths by developing new consulting services, winning work and leading projects.

You will work with our technical specialists to identify where clients need advice beyond due diligence, develop services we are well placed to deliver, and take them to clients. You will also lead the projects you win, bringing in specialists as needed.

Your impact at Infrata

The role has three main responsibilities: developing services, winning work and leading delivery.

- Develop services. Work with clients and colleagues to identify problems we have the expertise to address but do not currently advise on. Develop services we can deliver consistently, with a clear scope, team, price and evidence of their value.

- Win work. Introduce these services to existing and new clients, lead proposals and presentations, and secure new projects.

- Lead delivery. Lead the projects you win, agreeing the approach, managing the client relationship and team, and taking responsibility for the quality of the advice. Our due diligence specialists will contribute their expertise; you will be responsible for the overall engagement.

Key accountabilities

Service development

- Understand the team's expertise and identify opportunities to offer advisory services beyond due diligence.

- Test ideas with clients before investing in their development, and focus on those with genuine demand.

- Define the client need, approach, team, fees and deliverables for each service, supported by evidence of our experience.

- Build the supporting material: credentials, case studies, proposal templates, pitch decks.

- Identify opportunities to sell Infrata's data and analytical tools as products or recurring services, and assess whether they are commercially viable. You will establish what clients would pay for and work with our data and technology colleagues to develop it; you are not expected to build the technology yourself.

Business development

- Carry a personal sales target for new strategic advisory work (target to be agreed at offer).

- Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at investors, lenders, operators and public bodies.

- Identify opportunities, qualify them, and write or lead proposals and pitches.

- Work with sector leads to extend existing due diligence relationships into advisory work.

- Keep the pipeline and client records in our systems current.

Engagement leadership

- Act as lead consultant on engagements you win: scope, plan, staff, budget, and deliver.

- Define the questions the project needs to answer and the analysis required. Take responsibility for the conclusions and final recommendations.

- Manage the client relationship day to day, including scope changes, difficult messages and sign-off.

- Run the project team, including specialists drawn from across Infrata and dss+, and give them clear briefs and feedback.

- Deliver high-quality work on time and within budget, building client confidence and opportunities for further work.

Building the team's consulting capability

- Coach due diligence staff who work on your engagements in consulting skills: problem structuring, client handling, writing for decision-makers, presenting.

- Set clear standards for strategic advisory proposals, workplans and deliverables, and apply them in your own work.

- Help improve resourcing, time recording, project management and cash collection across Infrata.

Service areas in scope

The role covers four service areas. You should have the experience to lead projects in at least one of these areas and be comfortable selling services across all four.

Strategy
You will advise owners, operators, developers and public bodies on areas including market entry and growth strategy, asset and portfolio strategy, business planning, governance and assurance, policy and regulatory positioning, and investment case development.

Value creation
Working primarily with private equity and infrastructure fund investors and their portfolio companies, you will lead engagements such as full-potential reviews, 100-day plans, operational and commercial improvement programmes, exit readiness and portfolio performance reviews.

Climate advisory
You will support investors, lenders and operators with decarbonisation roadmaps, climate risk and resilience assessments, transition planning, sustainability strategy, and ESG and climate reporting.

Data and digital services
You will help investors, lenders, operators and public bodies get greater value from data. This could include turning existing traffic, asset, transaction and benchmark data into advisory products or subscription services, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery, and helping clients make better use of their own data.

Most projects will combine Infrata's knowledge of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy and digital infrastructure with dss+ expertise in operations, safety and sustainability.

Who you are

Essential experience

- At least eight years in management consulting, strategy consulting or advisory, including substantial experience in infrastructure. A background in project finance, lender's or investor's technical advisory, or assurance would help you understand our clients' needs and how our team works.

- Experience leading strategy, value creation or climate advisory projects, with responsibility for the engagement rather than an individual part of the work.

- Direct experience of winning work: writing proposals, pitching, negotiating scope and fees, and converting relationships into revenue.

- Experience developing or launching a new service, product or practice area, including on a small scale.

- Experience leading mixed teams of generalists and technical specialists.

Desirable

- Hands-on experience of project finance, due diligence or technical assurance on infrastructure transactions, and of the lenders, investors and sponsors involved.

- Experience working with private equity or infrastructure fund investors on portfolio companies.

- Sector depth in one of aviation, maritime, roads, rail, energy or digital infrastructure.

- Climate, decarbonisation or sustainability advisory experience.

- Experience commercialising data, analytics or digital products within a professional services business.

- A second European language, or experience working with teams in Spain, Latin America or Canada.

Capabilities

- Can make sense of complex or poorly defined problems and explain them clearly.

- Writes and presents for senior decision-makers.

- Exercises sound commercial judgement on project costs, fees and which opportunities to pursue.

- Comfortable with technical detail without needing to be the technical expert.

- Uses AI and data tools confidently and understands when they are useful for clients and when they are not. Technical development skills are not required.

- Works well with technical specialists, including those new to consulting, earning their trust and helping them contribute effectively.

- Takes initiative and is comfortable developing new services and ways of working, particularly in the first year.

Education and languages

- Degree in engineering, economics, finance, business, environmental science or a related discipline. MBA or equivalent is useful but not required.

- Fluent English.

Mobility

- Willing to travel to clients and to Infrata and dss+ offices as the work requires.

What you'll experience at dss+

- Work alongside investors, lenders, operators and governments on live infrastructure decisions.

- The opportunity to help build our strategic advisory practice.

- A values-led organisation and a collaborative, inclusive culture.

- Competitive compensation, performance incentives, flexible working and international opportunities.

dss+ is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, valued and able to contribute fully.

title: Consumer PR - Business Director
description:
Consumer PR - Business Director

Department: Consumer PR & Influence
Location: London
Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Managing Partner 

 

About Ogilvy: 

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International.

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally; we are proud to be the most awarded influencer agency for eight years running and the recipient of the Cannes Grand Prix for Social & Creator for two consecutive years.  
 
 

The Role: 

As Business Director you will lead client partnership, strategic counsel and integrated delivery across the portfolio, designed to provide the client with fully focused, senior leadership on some of the world’s most iconic FMCG brands. 

The role sits at the intersection of earned-first thinking, culture-led marketing, and integrated agency delivery, ensuring that PR, social, influence and advertising work together to create impact at scale across diverse markets. 
 
This pivotal role places you at the heart of our operations for large FMCG portfolio, one of the world's most iconic and dynamic brands.  

Your remit will span from the initial spark of ideation – identifying trends and innovative opportunities that drive cultural relevance – through the meticulous development of cutting-edge strategies tailored to diverse market nuances and brand objectives. You will lead the charge on defining compelling creative narratives and content frameworks, ensuring brand consistency and breakthrough engagement. Subsequently, you will oversee flawless execution, transforming strategy into impactful activations across various platforms and geographies.  

This role demands a holistic leader capable of driving innovation, navigating complex client relationships, and delivering measurable results within a dynamic, multi-market agency environment. 
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Client leadership & stakeholder management 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead for European and Global teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Provide strategic counsel across brand, reputation, partnerships and cultural activation
  • Lead complex, multi-market stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams
  • Ensure the FMCG Brand has consistent, senior-level leadership fully embedded in the brand business 

Global & European strategy development 

  • Lead the creation of global and European communications toolkits, frameworks and playbooks that balance global brand consistency with local market nuance
  • Embed earned-first thinking into all toolkits
  • Partner closely with creative and strategy leads to shape culturally relevant, insight-led ideas 

Market management & intelligence 

  • Oversee market engagement across Europe and priority global territories, acting as a central connector between the brands global teams and local markets
  • Ensure clients are consistently informed on market trends, cultural shifts, competitor activity and emerging opportunities
  • Champion local market insight, ensuring work is adaptable, relevant and executable across diverse regions 

Global events & partnerships 

  • Lead the communications strategy and delivery for global brand moments and events, ensuring alignment across markets
  • Play a central role in developing and activating brand partnerships, embedding them seamlessly into toolkits and campaign narratives
  • Work with market and agency leads to bring partnerships to life in locally relevant, culturally resonant ways 

Team leadership & integration 

  • Directly manage a London-based team, working alongside creative and strategy leadership
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture grounded in integration and shared ownership 

What makes this role different: 

  • 100% dedicated to the FMCG portfolio, allowing for deep brand immersion and long-term strategic thinking
  • Operates at true global scale, balancing global brand stewardship with local market realities
  • Deeply partnership-led, with collaborations embedded into brand strategy
  • Strong emphasis on earned-first, culture-first marketing, influencing how integrated campaigns are built from the ground up
  • Sits within a fully integrated agency model, requiring constant collaboration across discipline 

 

Key Leadership Competencies: 

  • Proven experience in global and/or European leadership roles, ideally within FMCG or large-scale consumer brands 
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — this role is heavily relationship-driven and requires confidence navigating complexity 
  • Strong understanding of how global brands operate across markets, with sensitivity to cultural and market nuance 
  • Demonstrated experience working in integrated agency environments across PR, advertising, social and influence 
  • A passion for culture-led, earned-first marketing and its role in driving brand relevance and business impact 
  • Commercially astute, strategically minded and comfortable operating at senior client level 
  • A genuine interest in — and affinity for — the drinks brands and the wider FMCG landscape 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Defines and communicates the overarching vision for the Influence practice. Develops communication strategies that align the department with agency leadership and fosters a culture of open dialogue and mentorship for senior leaders. 
  • Organisation & Resource Management: Architects the department's operational structure to support profitability and growth. Oversees P&L, leads resource forecasting, and ensures the practice is structured to handle complex, large-scale business needs. 
  • Responsibility & Accountability: Holds ultimate accountability for the entire department's commercial and creative performance. Empowers directors to lead their teams while maintaining transparent, high-level communication with executive leadership on business progress and challenges. 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Acts as the final point of authority on the most critical business issues. Makes high-stakes decisions that protect the agency's commercial interests and mentors directors in strategic problem-solving. 
  • Growth & Development: Champions and funds a departmental learning culture. Defines the long-term talent strategy, creates career pathways for all levels, and builds a best-in-class team through senior hiring and mentorship.

title: Principal Penetration Tester
description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

Our Professional Services Team is seeking Associate Principal OT Penetration Tester who will provide technical leadership across vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and adversary emulation activities supporting customer services engagements. You will shape engagement strategy and uncover real‑world attack paths across ICS/OT networks through hands‑on exploitation and deep technical analysis, working closely with customers across critical infrastructure sectors such as oil and gas, electric, water treatment, and manufacturing. You will also translate findings into clear, actionable remediation guidance, influencing detection and platform development. You will mentor team members and be an advisor and representative of Dragos within the broader OT security community.

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as primary technical lead and trusted advisor for Dragos’s most complex, high-impact industrial penetration testing, purple teaming, and vulnerability assessment engagements, shaping engagement direction and aligning deep technical execution with client business goals.
  • Set the technical bar for OT penetration testing excellence by defining methodologies, assessment frameworks, and red team tactics informed by threat intelligence and adversary emulation. Design and lead offensive campaigns modeled on known and unknown TTPs to uncover complex attack paths across IT/OT boundaries and within industrial environments.
  • Translate hands-on findings into strategic R&D priorities, guiding the development of proprietary tools, behavioral analytics, and detection content by identifying gaps in visibility, response, and prevention in customer environments.
  • Evolve internal playbooks, runbooks, and operating procedures, applying field lessons, threat intelligence, and emerging adversary behaviors to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of the penetration testing practice.
  • Engage executive stakeholders, internally and externally, with strategic cybersecurity guidance, risk prioritization, and remediation recommendations tied to business objectives, delivering clear, authoritative presentations to C-suites, boards, and technical leadership.
  • Represent Dragos as an industry thought leader through original research, top-tier conference presentations, whitepapers, and public engagements that advance OT security with unique insights and innovation.
  • Mentor engineering, threat intelligence, and consulting teams across functions, cultivating future leaders and a culture of continuous learning, technical curiosity, and mission-driven execution.

Qualifications: 

  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or red teaming within the OT space, with in-depth knowledge of OT penetration testing methodologies in white, gray, and black-box contexts.
  • Deep understanding of OT-specific architectures and services, including DCS, historians, SCADA networks, transmission/distribution management, AMI, related communication protocols, and other control systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of OT cyber threats, attack paths, exploits, and adversary TTPs.
  • Hands-on experience with offensive security tooling such as Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, Cobalt Strike, Burp Suite, common LOTL toolsets, and C2 frameworks.
  • Advanced experience with networking components (routers, switches, load balancers, firewalls), plus the ability to analyze network traffic and host data in a cybersecurity context.
  • Proven experience using large language models (e.g., Claude) to support penetration testing execution and reporting, including reconnaissance, exploit development, and drafting findings, with sound judgment in validating AI-generated output and securely handling client data.
  • Strong report-writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate across distributed teams, with willingness to travel up to 30-40% (domestic and international) to support customer engagements.

Compensation: 

  • Salary: £105,000
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Working alongside our existing Principal Technical SEO, you will co-own technical SEO across our Gaming portfolio, while also supporting our Sports portfolio.

This is a deeply hands-on role where you will solve complex challenges across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, internationalisation, migrations and performance, while setting standards that scale across our portfolio.

You will also play a key role in advancing how we use AI and automation across SEO. You will build tools, monitoring, diagnostics and automated workflows yourself, using technology to improve the speed and quality of decision-making and helping our wider SEO teams adopt these capabilities.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and visibility. You will lead through expertise rather than formal authority, working alongside senior specialists and leaders across SEO, Product, Engineering and Analytics to shape decisions across the organisation.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

  • Co-own our portfolio-wide technical SEO strategy, roadmap and standards, identifying and prioritising the opportunities and risks with the greatest potential organic and commercial impact.
  • Lead complex technical investigations across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, international SEO, migrations, structured data and web performance.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on architecture, major releases, migrations and experimentation, translating technical SEO insights into clear priorities and scalable solutions.
  • Build automated monitoring, diagnostics and early-warning systems that identify material technical issues before they become significant commercial problems.
  • Develop internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that improve analysis, quality assurance, prioritisation and execution across technical SEO and the wider SEO organisation.
  • Create reusable technical patterns, guardrails and frameworks across our portfolio, raising technical capability through coaching, documentation and shared tooling.

What You'll Bring:

  • Repeated technical SEO impact at scale- a strong track record of personally leading complex technical SEO initiatives across large websites or multi-domain portfolios, with clear evidence of measurable organic or commercial outcomes.
  • Exceptional technical SEO depth and judgement- expert knowledge across crawling, rendering, indexation, architecture, internal linking, canonicalisation, international SEO, migrations, structured data, JavaScript SEO, log-file analysis and web performance, with the judgement to separate material opportunities from technical hygiene.
  • Commercial and strategic thinking- able to translate complex technical findings into priorities based on expected value, risk, effort, confidence and opportunity cost, connecting technical decisions to organic and commercial outcomes.
  • Principal-level influence- experienced in influencing Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders without direct authority, challenging constructively and communicating complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A builder's mindset- intellectually curious, technically self-sufficient and comfortable remaining deeply hands-on while creating systems, standards and capabilities that increase the impact of teams beyond your own individual contribution.

The Interview Process:

1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom.

2nd: Interview with our Chief Gaming Officer - 60 minutes via Zoom.

3rd: Technical SEO interview with senior members of our SEO team - 60 minutes via Zoom.

4th: Case presentation and Principal peer interview - 90 minutes via Zoom, including a technical SEO assessment prepared ahead of the interview.

Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.

Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more.

As a Research Intern, you will work directly with world-class machine learning scientists, statisticians, and technical innovators. You will be at the forefront of modern statistical machine learning innovation, applying novel research to large, high-dimensional data sets. This role is a means to make a difference: together with other Members of Research Staff, you will have an enduring impact on our field.

 

Responsibilities

  • Work on complex problems with a research team that has collectively published hundreds of academic articles in top-tier venues on machine learning, systems, and theory

  • Apply expertise in a technical field such as statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or operations research, to challenging problems in a burgeoning technical field

  • Develop predictive models and other components of automated trading systems

  • Engage in work ranging from data preparation to model development to production software implementation

Requirements

  • Current graduate student in a quantitative discipline, expecting to attain a Ph.D. degree in December 2027, or anytime in 2028

  • Background in modern statistical methods and machine learning

  • Key contributions to multiple top tier publications

  • Programming experience and interest in software development techniques

  • Authorization to work in the United Kingdom

Interest in financial applications is essential, but experience in finance is not a primary factor in our hiring

For more details regarding eligibility, terms and conditions please make sure to review the Voleon Referral Bonus Program.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
London or Sheffield - 2 days per week in office, 3 days working remotely

ABOUT THE ROLE

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re on the hunt for a Business Systems Analyst to help us achieve this.

The Business Systems team plays a crucial role in driving efficiency across multiple departments including Sales, Customer Support, Marketing and Finance by optimising our internal processes and connected ecosystem. As a hands-on analyst, you will work throughout the full SDLC: partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their challenges, scoping scalable solutions, and implementing them directly in Salesforce.

Your work will be critical to driving business growth and achieving our strategic goals. To accomplish this, you will employ advanced automation and Salesforce’s latest AI capabilities to solve real business problems rather than just completing tasks. You will ensure robust data governance, seamless integrations with platforms like HubSpot, and disciplined process execution.

No two days are ever the same at Goodlord so what you’ll be up to will vary. The pace we move at also means priorities will change and you’ll need to be comfortable with this (we’ll support you!). But these are the things that will be core to your role and will keep you busy.

The day-to-day stuff:

- Flexibly balance a mix of business as usual system admin tasks alongside the execution of long-term, strategic projects.

- Partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their operational challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, documented technical specifications.

- Own the administration, configuration, and day-to-day support of core enablement tools and integrations, including GetAccept, Vonage, and HubSpot.

- Map, manage and continuously improve the operational processes underlying our sales cycles.

- Utilise Salesforce reporting, Data Loader, Import Wizard, etc to maintain an accurate database, while building visibility (dashboards/reports) for everyone from end-users to the executive team.

- Proactively spot, triage, and systematically debug new system, AI, or process issues as they arise, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

ABOUT YOU

You should apply if you:

- Hands-on experience in Salesforce configuration and advanced declarative automation. Understanding of best-practice configuration to prevent over-customization.

- Working familiarity of modern Salesforce AI capabilities with a keen eye for identifying where AI can solve real-world business challenges, automate manual tasks, and drive operational efficiency.

- Experience partnering with business stakeholders to map business processes, challenge assumptions, and translate pain points into scalable solutions rather than just "taking orders."

- Literacy in integration logic, data sync behaviors, and APIs (e.g., interfacing Salesforce with HubSpot and plugins like GetAccept).

- A systematic approach to debugging, documentation, and testing along with strict adherence to internal change management processes.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

- Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

- Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

- 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

- Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

- Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.

** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

- Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.

- Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.

- Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.

- Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.

- Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.

- Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.

- Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

- On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.

- Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.

- Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.

- Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

- Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.

- Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.

- Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).

- Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.

- Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.

- Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation and Benefits

- Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

- Time off: 49 days paid time off

- Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

- Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

- Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

- London

- San Francisco

- Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

- Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

- Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

- A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

- Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

title: Head of Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description:
Hi 👋🏾, I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and CTO. Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.

We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!

The Role

In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:

- Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure.

- Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).

- Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!

- Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.

- Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.

- You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.

- If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues!

The Qualifications

We’re entrusting you with a company priority, so we want you to know how to scale products and build the great teams that do that. This means:

- You played an important role leading a company through a high-growth period (either as an IC Lead or Engineering Leader). You had to make high-quality decisions under pressure. That often meant striking a balance between short-term fixes to keep the product from falling over and long-term investments to ensure it didn’t happen again.

- You have experience hiring and building hiring processes, and enjoy it! You’ve designed interviews, interview loops, and led hiring strategy.

- You have a track record of excellent collaboration with other departments. You were a key contributor to company-level initiatives that involved Product Engineering, Product, Sales, or Support. Those departments felt heard and supported, yet positively challenged by you.

- You are knowledgeable about platform and infrastructure technologies, networking, and hardware. You know how Kubernetes goes beyond a Container Orchestration Platform, how traffic flows between Load Balancers and Pods, and how the intricacies of the underlying hardware can cause Cloud abstractions to break, etc.

- You are a great communicator, particularly in writing. You’ll need to be able to go deep with Infrastructure Engineers in conversations while also communicating those concepts to folks like myself who have much less experience.

You should be comfortable managing a team spanning from the Americas West Coast to Europe. You’ll be able to hire managers to focus on specific time zones, but I expect you to have skips with some engineers (and you should want to, too!). To ensure a reasonable work schedule, we’re only hiring candidates who live in the PST-GMT time zone.

What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

- You’ve always been a line manager or never led a department within Engineering. You haven’t led the definition and evolution of culture and processes.

- You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology. We believe great leaders are folks who were great engineers themselves. That starts with loving the craft and never giving it up.

- You went into management because it was the only growth path available. We want folks who could have been Principal engineers (or were one!).

- You're happy with a team of engineers who are predominantly early-career or mid-career or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. You believe that with enough guardrails, the team can get things done.

- To you, a Staff or Principal Engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or conducting architecture reviews. You don’t believe staff and principal engineers could lead by the example they set or the leverage they create through their work.

- You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently from the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers or consistency.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:

- Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design

- Natural collaboration and deliberate communication

- Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage, including LLM-driven dev tooling.

- Putting effort into building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They often discovered problems, prioritized the right ones, and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). title: GTM Recruiter
description:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

- Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.

- Do truly great work

- Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

The role:

We’re at an exciting inflection point: strong customer love, clear product–market fit, and accelerating growth. As our GTM Recruiter, you’ll partner directly with GTM leadership to build a world-class commercial organization. You’ll own the full GTM recruiting lifecycle with an emphasis on Sales, while also building on the foundational systems, processes, and tools that will scale our hiring engine. All while working within the business operating at the bleeding edge of how hiring gets done with AI.

Key ownership areas:

- Partner with the Co-founder/CEO and GTM leaders to define hiring needs across Sales, CS, and Marketing.

- Own end-to-end recruiting for GTM roles: sourcing, outreach, screening, stakeholder alignment, interviews, and offer processes.

- Refine our recruiting infrastructure and keep making it sharper.

- The bigger opportunity: build a hiring machine that combines systematic rigour with human judgement; 100x'ing our capacity and leaving the competition at the starting line.

- Develop genuine expertise in GTM talent markets. Where the best operators are, what they care about, what it takes to land them.

- Keep leadership honest. Surface pipeline realities and translate them into clear, data-driven decisions, trade-offs, and next steps.

What you bring:

- 3+ years in full-cycle recruiting at a fast-paced, high-growth B2B startup (experience hiring for GTM roles desirable)

- A skilled assessor with an unusually high bar for talent. You can assess the intangibles that separate exceptional candidates from competent ones, and sell the opportunity in the same breath.

- A network, or the hunger and discipline to build one fast. You know where the best GTM operators are, what they care about, and how to get their attention.

- AI-native. You've already figured out how to use it to move faster and hire better. You're not waiting for permission or a playbook.

- Comfortable partnering directly with founders and GTM leaders. You can push back, hold the line on bar, and earn trust doing both.

- A hunter mentality. The GTM talent market doesn't give up its best people easily. You'll find a way.

What we offer:

- The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

- Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

- High compensation, through cash and equity.

- All the benefits you’d expect and more.

title: Talent Development Specialist
description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

The Talent Development Specialist is a hands-on operator building the learning experience for an AI-first organization. You’ll design and build learning that people actually use, manage the platform’s daily execution, and run compliance campaigns at scale. You’ll partner with leadership and the AI transformation team to translate how Snyk works into learning that sticks. This is a mix of designing, building, running, and improving—skills you’ll develop across each dimension. You’ll identify where AI workflows remove friction from L&D and People Ops, and you’ll ship them. You’re helping people develop the capabilities they need to thrive as AI reshapes how we build, collaborate, and secure software. This role sits at the intersection of planning and execution, learning and operations, where you own impact from build to outcome.

What You’ll Do:

title: Brand Designer, Web
description:
TL;DR — We're seeking an exceptional Brand Designer to own the visual direction and craft of our website. You'll shape how Lovable looks, feels and communicates online - working closely with design engineering and marketing to turn ideas into world-class web experiences.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

- 7+ years of experience, with a portfolio of shipped websites that demonstrate strong visual craft and brand thinking

- Portfolio showing landing pages, brand systems, or marketing sites where design decisions clearly serve the story (if your portfolio is mostly product/UI work - check out our other roles)

- A sharp eye for typography, layout, color, and motion, with the taste to know what's on-brand and what isn't

- Comfort designing directly for the web - you think in real breakpoints, real type scales, and real constraints, not just static comps

- Ability to systematise creative choices in design systems - contributing to a shared design system across both product and brand

- Experience partnering closely with design engineers to get explorations into production without losing the soul of the idea

- You’re no stranger to shipping your own designs directly to production - perhaps with a little help from AI

- Ideally - you've got a point of view on where web design is headed and aren't afraid to push for something unexpected

- We’re prioritising candidates based in London or Stockholm, or willing to relocate

What you'll do

In one sentence: Own the visual and brand craft of Lovable's website, making sure every page feels unmistakably Lovable.

- Design landing pages, campaign sites, and web experiences that make people stop scrolling

- Set and evolve the visual language for lovable.dev - typography, layout systems, imagery, motion principles

- Pair closely with design engineering to translate explorations into scalable, web-native implementations, staying involved through to shipped pixels

- Collaborate with marketing and brand to make sure the website tells the right story at the right moment - launches, campaigns, positioning shifts

- Build and maintain a visual system that keeps the site consistent while leaving room for creative surprises

- Bring a strong opinion on craft and hold the line on quality, even under deadline pressure

- Help define what "world-class" looks like for marketing sites

How we hire

- Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

- Show us some of your work you're really proud of.

- Walk us through your process and craft across several design interviews.

- In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

- Please submit your application in English — it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join

- We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

title: (Senior) Partnership Manager - UK (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Join Moss as a Partnerships Manager (f/m/d) and become part of our fastest-growing team. With new leadership in place and partnerships central to our 2027 growth strategy, we’re scaling our channel business—and looking for people who want to help drive that growth.

You’ll source, win and grow high-value channel partnerships, taking ownership of relationships from the first conversation through to delivering revenue. Working closely with our Senior Director of Partnerships and Head of Channel, you’ll execute a focused channel strategy, build productive partner relationships and make a measurable contribution to Moss’ growth.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

- Partner Identification & Assessment - Identify potential partnership opportunities that align with Moss' strategic goals and target markets. Conduct thorough assessments to evaluate the suitability and potential value of prospective partners.

- Relationship Building - Cultivate and nurture relationships with existing and potential partners. Establish rapport, engage in effective communication, and maintain regular contact to foster strong, mutually beneficial partnerships.

- Negotiation & Agreement - Lead negotiations with partners to create and finalize agreements, ensuring that commercial terms are beneficial. Collaborate closely with legal and executive teams to ensure contract compliance and risk mitigation.

- Revenue Generation - Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth through partnerships. This may include joint marketing campaigns, co-selling initiatives, and referral programs. Continuously monitor and optimize partnership performance to maximize financial outcomes.

- Cross-functional Collaboration - Collaborate with various internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Support to align partnership activities with Moss' overall business goals. Ensure seamless coordination and communication across departments to execute partnership initiatives effectively.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

- Proven experience in B2B partnership roles or business development in a fast-growing SaaS or financial services company

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Trusted partner: you quickly establish strong credibility with partners, identifying synergies to build lasting relationships.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: you are always on the lookout for new partnerships, ready to generate high impact for Moss. You approach lead generation in an efficient and pragmatic way, understanding partners' processes and leveraging insights for joint revenue opportunities.

- Ownership: you fully own your tasks, your constant learning progress and partner relationships, proactively overcoming obstacles and ensuring success aligned with broader business goals.

- Collaborative Spirit: you proactively collaborate within your team, and with internal and external stakeholders to create a best-in-class partner and customer experience.

- Resilient: you bounce back swiftly and independently of challenges, setbacks, or complex situations, displaying a willingness to learn and improve strategies for working with partners and within Moss.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

- Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.

- Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

- Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
description:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Manager, avec une légitimité et une réussite reconnues sur des produits complexes ou de plateforme.

  • Expertise Technique & Data : Tu possèdes une forte appétence technique ainsi qu'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des données, aux accès et à la gouvernance. Savoir manipuler la donnée est un réel plus pour ce poste.

  • Culture Tech & IA : Tu maîtrises les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle appliqués au Product Management et tu appréhendes parfaitement les défis techniques sous-jacents (sécurité, infrastructure, scalabilité).

  • Soft Skills : Orienté·e utilisateur, tu as un fort sens du service. Tu aimes écouter, creuser des sujets de fond et proposer des solutions innovantes.

  • Communication & Fédérateur·rice : Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités de communication pour vulgariser des concepts complexes, dialoguer aussi bien avec des profils techniques que métiers, et fédérer autour de ta vision.

  • Langues & Mindset : Un niveau d'anglais courant (B2 minimum, écrit et oral) est requis pour évoluer dans notre contexte international. Tu es motivé·e, curieux·se, ambitieux·se et tu as le goût du challenge.

  • L'étincelle Decathlon : Tu es passionné·e de sport, tu as envie de partager tes passions en équipe et de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif !


STACK TECHNIQUE

  • AWS S3, Glue
  • Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog
  • Data contracts
  • Business Intelligence : Tableau
  • Compute et Orchestration : Spark / Scala,  Python,  Airflow, dbt
  • Ops : Terraform, Kubernetes
  • Product Management : Jira Product Discovery, Github, Confluence
  • IA : Gemini, Github Copilot

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

 

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. title: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)
description:
Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)      


L’équipe Login est le pilier de l’écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d'une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d’authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d’entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d'architecture d'envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné·es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

La mission principale est d’accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l’amélioration de l’application, le tout tournant autour d’une organisation s’appuyant sur un écosystème agile afin de délivrer rapidement et fréquemment le plus de valeur possible à nos produits.

Contexte DevSecOps : you build it, you run it, you enjoy it !

  • Security by Design

Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC : Contribuer à l'implémentation de ces protocoles pour garantir des accès sécurisés à nos services.

Sécurisation du Code : Appliquer les principes de sécurité dès la conception (OWASP, protection contre les injections, gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des sessions).

Veille Sécurité : Identifier et corriger proactivement les failles potentielles au sein de l'écosystème Java/Spring.

Administration Cloudflare : Gérer, configurer et optimiser notre infrastructure Cloudflare (WAF, protection DDoS, DNS, CDN, Gestion des Bots). 

Audit et Monitoring : Mettre en place la surveillance des menaces, analyser les logs de sécurité et réagir aux incidents (SOC/SIEM).

  • Développement & Delivery

Production : Assurer le delivery sur les briques core du CIAM (moteurs d'authentification, gestion des jetons, intégrations protocolaires).

Patterns Avancés : Implémenter des solutions résilientes basées sur Kafka (Patterns CDC & Outbox) pour garantir la cohérence des données sans compromettre la performance.

Qualité Intégrée : Garantir la stabilité via des tests automatisés rigoureux (Playwright, Gatling) dès la phase de développement.

  •  Pilotage par la Donnée : Tracking & A/B Testing

Expérimentation : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'A/B testing via Statsig pour valider les évolutions du tunnel d'authentification de manière granulaire.

Tracking Comportemental : Intégrer et maintenir un tracking précis via Amplitude pour analyser les parcours utilisateurs et identifier les points de friction.

Performance Produit : Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour traduire les besoins business en implémentations techniques mesurables et scalables.

  • Architecture, Scale & Observabilité

Conception Système : Modéliser les flux complexes via le C4 Model pour assurer une vision claire des interactions entre services.

Infrastructure & Ops : Déployer et opérer tes services sur Kubernetes (Helm), avec une maîtrise totale de l'observabilité via Datadog.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • +7 ans en Java dans des environnements distribués à fort trafic.
  • Compétence sécurité : 
    • Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC
    • Expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent
    • Sécurisation du Code (OWASP, injections, sessions sécurisées)
  • Spring & Spring Security : Connaissance des mécanismes internes (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.).
  • Event-Driven Architecture : Expérience sur Kafka, CDC et utilisation du pattern Outbox.
  • Data & Growth : Expérience sur des outils de tracking (Amplitude) et de Feature Flagging / A/B testing (Statsig).
  • Cloud & Tools : Kubernetes, Helm, Datadog.
  • Testing : Playwright (E2E) et Gatling/Blazemeter (Load testing).
  • Langue : Anglais technique (documentation impérative).

Organisation de travail hybride ;

Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).
