title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
description:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems 

 

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in distributed systems and ML infrastructure for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • You are proficient in Python and in at least one systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go) ● You have experience operating large-scale training or serving infrastructure, or schedulers and orchestration systems for GPU or other high-performance workloads
  • You understand what limits throughput/latency in distributed inference workloads: communication, memory, scheduling, and stragglers
  • You have strong debugging, profiling, and incident-diagnosis skills, ideally including on-call experience 
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Prior experience training machine learning models is valuable but not essential for engineers with strong distributed systems or HPC backgrounds 

 

Bonus Points (any of the following): 

  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, including batching and KV-cache management

title: General Counsel at amo
description:
amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump and Sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

The role:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

How we think about legal:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. title: AMI Scientist - Geometry and 3D Vision
description:
About AMI

We are building a new breed of AI systems that (1) understand the real world, (2) have persistent memory, (3) can reason and plan, and (4) are controllable and safe.

We are a team of scientists and engineers building frontier world model-based AI. We combine the scientific rigor of a top-tier research institute with focus on engineering excellence and execution.

We are a global company, with offices in Paris, Montreal, New York, and Singapore. Come build the future of AI with us!

About this Role

AMI believes AI agents should predict and plan using an internal model of the world — their world model. We’re looking for new team members to advance the state-of-the-art in world modeling. We believe that video is a rich and abundant source of data reflecting how the world works, and that in general models need to be able to process continuous, high-dimensional data from a variety of sensors to: (a) understand context about the current state of the physical world, (b) make predictions about how the world will evolve, possibly as a result of actions taken, and (c) plan and adapt sequences of actions to complete complex tasks, possibly in dynamic, complex environments.

You will work with a team on world model research efforts, with a specific focus on 3D geometry of the real world, including::

- Self-supervised learning methods to efficiently learn from video and other continuous, high-dimensional signals

- New architectures that efficiently learn to predict world dynamics from video and other high-dimensional signals

- Scalable algorithms for pre-processing and curating video data

- Evaluations for benchmarking world model understanding, prediction, and planning

- Efficient algorithms for model-based planning and reasoning

Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field

- Proficiency in Python

- Ability to design, run, and analyze experiments independently

- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, large-scale training, and accelerator-based (GPU or TPU) compute environments

Preferred Qualifications:

- Deep expertise in at least one of the following: 3D/4D reconstruction, SLAM or SfM, depth and pose estimation, point tracking.

- Hands-on proficiency with a rendering or simulation engine (Blender, Isaac Sim, etc.), including scripted scene generation and batch rendering pipelines.

- Demonstrated record of contributing to advanced research projects via publications and/or major model releases

- Experience developing evaluation frameworks for world models

- Experience releasing and maintaining open-source projects

- Proficiency in a deep learning framework (PyTorch or JAX)

title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
description:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

- Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
- Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
- Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

- Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
- Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
- Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
- Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

- Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
- Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
- Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
- Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

- PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
- Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
- Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
- Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
- Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
- Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

- Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
- Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
- Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
- Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

- Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
- Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution:

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

- Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.
- Public transport subscription covered at 50%.
- Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car).
- Fully covered health insurance (Alan).
- Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate).
- Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses.
- Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib).
- Meal subsidies (Swile).

Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem.

Process:

- Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
- Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
- Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
- Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
- Reference checks
- Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern (6 months)
description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Talent Acquisition Intern to help us hire the interns and apprentices shaping Qonto's next generation of talent. You'll screen and source across Tech, Product and Business, working closely with our 25+ Talent Acquisition Managers, under the guidance of Aurélien, our Head of Talent Acquisition.

➡️ What you'll do

- Hire our interns and apprentices: Alongside the other TA intern, you'll own CV screening and sourcing for every intern and apprentice role, across all teams.

- Support senior hiring: You'll analyse the labour market to find candidates for critical, senior roles when needed.

- Sharpen our process: You'll spot friction points in our hiring process and help fix them.

- Drive TA projects: You'll contribute to initiatives like campus management, salary and perks benchmarking, and tooling improvements.

➡️ What we're looking for

- Still studying, close to the finish line: You're pursuing a French Master's (or equivalent) in HR Management or a related field, and looking for your end-of-study internship.

- Fluent in French and English: German, Spanish or Italian is a plus.

- Hands-on and organised: You can juggle multiple priorities and keep a hiring process moving at pace.

- A natural communicator: You'll represent Qonto to candidates, so you're comfortable presenting yourself and building rapport fast.

- Open to working with AI: You're comfortable using AI tools to speed up screening, sourcing and admin work.

➡️ What we can offer you

- A truly international team: Recruiters across France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Austria and Belgium 🇫🇷🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇵🇹🇦🇹🇧🇪.

- Real ownership from day one: You and the other TA intern will run intern & apprentice hiring end-to-end, not just support it.

- Exposure beyond your scope: You'll get pulled into senior hiring and strategic TA projects most interns never touch.

- A front-row seat on scaling TA: You'll see up close how a 20+ person team hires at Qonto's pace.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Aurélien, our Head of Talent Acquisition since July 2023, leading a team of 20+ recruiters hiring talent worldwide. Before Qonto, he spent years in executive search across France and Europe. He's hands-on and genuinely invested in making recruitment sharper and more effective for everyone involved.

Perks

- Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.

[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Join us as an AI Engineer in our AI Products team to make sure the AI agents we ship are as reliable as they are fast to build. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank.

➡️ What you'll do

- Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers.

- Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot.

- Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk.

- Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early.

- Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents.

➡️ What we're looking for

- Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading.

- Strong ML foundations: You understand the ML lifecycle, from training and iteration to evaluation and monitoring, and core concepts such as overfitting, generalization and cross-validation.

- LLM and agentic systems knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs (particularly the Transformer architecture) and the building blocks of agentic systems. You know how to optimize an agent's harness (prompts, tools, hooks and orchestration) to improve its reliability and performance.

- Builder instinct and backend comfort: You've built and shipped something used by real users, whether professionally, during an internship or as a side project. You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, working with APIs and integrating systems.

- AI-native curiosity: You follow developments in AI closely, experiment with new approaches on your own and use AI tools daily in your work.

➡️ What we can offer you

- A rare problem: You'll make AI agents trustworthy in a regulated bank, where quality is not optional.

- Hands-on coaching: You'll learn directly from Pierre-Jean, one of the AI engineers in the team.

- Room to grow: Your scope grows as the platform opens to more teams.

- Space to experiment: You'll work at the frontier of AI in a team that keeps experimentation at its core.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Sophie Cornay, our Product Leader for AI Products.

- Her background? Sophie has led product teams in startups and established tech companies.

- What does she bring to the team? She gives engineers real ownership and space to experiment.

➡️ Our stack and practices

- Python and Pydantic-ai: Python is our baseline language, and Pydantic-ai is our agentic framework.

- AWS: We access our models through AWS.

- Grafana: We track usage and cost per sub-agent on it.

- GitHub and CI: Every agent change ships through a reviewed pull request.

- Braintrust: Evaluation and agent monitoring run on our self-hosted instance.

We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join Qonto as a Learning & Development Manager to maintain and elevate our learning programmes during a key period for the People team, ensuring Qontoers continue to access high-quality self-service content, group coaching, and tailored learning support.

You will work closely with Olivia (Knowledge & Learning Lead) and partner with managers and internal experts across Qonto to deliver impactful learning experiences, quickly and with a high bar.

➡️ What you’ll do

- Build and maintain our Sana catalogue: You’ll create and keep our self-service learning content current, grounded in real pain points you see on the ground.

- Run Manager Academy and workshops: You’ll design and personally facilitate sessions, adapting the format to what each team actually needs.

- Coach on Lean principles: You’ll help Qontoers embody continuous improvement and problem-solving at the source — this is how culture gets operationalised at Qonto.

- Move fast on ad hoc requests: Some training needs go from ask to delivery in under a week, and you’re the one who makes that happen.

➡️ What we’re looking for

- Solo ownership under pace: You can own a learning system end-to-end without a team of specialists behind you, and you move in days, not months, when something’s urgent.

- Programme design & pedagogy: You’ve built self-serve, tool-based learning content from scratch, with a clear read on what actually makes it stick.

- Facilitation & manager coaching: You’ve personally run workshops and coached managers — not just designed sessions for someone else to deliver.

- AI-native workflow: You use AI naturally to design, build, and iterate on content faster, not as an afterthought.

- Fluent in French and English: You’re comfortable working daily in both — most of the people and content you’ll work with are French and English speaking.

Familiarity with Lean Methodology is a genuine bonus, not a requirement — you’ll pick it up on the job either way.

➡️ What we can offer you

- Real autonomy, real visibility: Olivia is hiring at a senior level so you can own this scope with minimal oversight, not backfill a junior role.

- A system to build, not inherit: Our self-service learning catalogue on Sana is still taking shape — you’ll shape how it runs for the next phase of growth.

- A mix that stays interesting: Self-serve content, manager coaching, live workshops, and ad hoc requests — never just one lane.

- Room to grow with the company: Qonto’s heading toward 2 million customers by 2030, and L&D’s scope grows right along with it.

title: GPU Engineer
description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

- Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

- KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

- Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

- Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

- Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

- Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

- Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

- Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

- Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

- Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

- Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

- Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

- Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

- Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

- Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

- Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

title: Product Marketing Manager - Enterprise
description:
The Role

About H

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

Your role

At H, Product Marketing is the expert on our customers and our market. It decides how H is positioned and differentiated, and makes our value obvious.

H Company is seeking a Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise to help our sales teams win and grow our largest customers. You will own the messaging, enablement and proof that make our enterprise offer easy to understand, easy to trust and easy to buy, in long sales cycles with engineers, business leaders and the C-suite around the table.

This role is ideal for a hands-on product marketer who loves being close to the field and excels at turning complex technology into stories that convert. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineers, Product and Marketing to position H as the reference for AI agents in the enterprise.

What you will own

Voice of the customer

- Capture field feedback (objections, lost deals) and competitive insights to keep our messaging grounded in what AI transformation leaders actually care about

- Share insights with Product Marketing, Sales and Product to inform positioning and roadmap decisions

Positioning and messaging

- Adapt our product messaging for each audience (C-level, technical leaders, operational managers), translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories

- Build and maintain playbooks for our priority industries, use cases and personas

- Provide key messages and content used in acquisition campaigns

Sales enablement

- Build and maintain the sales kit (pitch deck, one-pagers, FAQ, battlecards, objection handling) for a sales team navigating long enterprise cycles

- Stay close to deals: listen to calls, join key meetings and track which materials work and which don’t

- Prepare Sales for model releases and product launches with materials and training

Proof and credibility

- Produce customer case studies, success stories and testimonials with our Forward Deployed Engineers and customers, to equip Sales and Marketing

- Run our analyst program: track and plan our participation, build and maintain a reusable answer library, and turn analyst recognition into GTM assets (one-pagers, website proof points, PR)

About you

An autonomous doer, comfortable close to the field, who knows how to move forward from an existing framework and make technical topics simple.

- Experience: 3 to 5 years in product marketing, sales enablement or solutions marketing, ideally in B2B tech with complex sales cycles and enterprise sales teams

- Environment: experience in fast-moving, international settings, ideally a startup, a scale-up or the AI sector

- Storytelling: you understand technical products and translate them into business value, with polished materials and sharp copy

- Cross-functional: you get things done with Sales, Product and RevOps

- AI-driven productivity: you use AI tools to produce faster without sacrificing quality

- Curiosity: you love new technologies

- Languages: fluent in English and French, written and spoken

Location

- Paris or London.

- This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

- Please expect some travel between offices on a reasonable cadence (e.g., every 4-6 weeks).

What We Offer

- Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups

- Collaborate with a fun, dynamic and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment

- Enjoy a competitive salary

- Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Stage - Chimie des matériaux et des surfaces pour la microfluidique
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Bienvenue chez Maison MGA une entreprise où l’innovation rencontre l’excellence humaine. Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est vivre une aventure professionnelle portée par la bienveillance, le challenge, la progression continue… et une bonne dose de convivialité !

Tu intégreras notre entité MGA MedTech basé à Mably (42) spécialisée dans le développement de solutions technologiques avancées dédiées au secteur médical et des dispositifs médicaux.

Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ?

Pour accompagner notre développement, nous proposons un stage de 4 à 6 mois en Chimie des matériaux et des surfaces pour la microfluidique.

Ton environnement et mission principale

Sous la responsabilité du Single Use Manager, tu interviens sur le développement de matériaux et de traitements de surface pour la fabrication et l’assemblage de puces microfluidiques en polymères.

Pour cela, tu auras l’opportunité de :

- Réaliser un état de l’art et évaluer des matériaux pour la réalisation de moules de microfabrication.
- Caractériser la durabilité des moules, leur fidélité de réplication et leur compatibilité avec les procédés de moulage.
- Développer des procédés de collage de puces thermoplastiques (PMMA, COC, COP) et valider leur étanchéité.
- Développer et caractériser des procédés de fonctionnalisation de surface (traitements plasma, silanisation, greffage).

♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ?

Tu es étudiant.e en chimie, matériaux polymères ou physico-chimie des surfaces.

Une expérience en caractérisation topographique (profilométrie, microscopie) serait un vrai plus.

Tu maîtrises l’anglais technique : tu es à l’aise pour lire des publications scientifiques et des fiches techniques.

Si tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent et participer au développement de technologies innovantes à impact, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec toi !

Tes avantages MGA

- Tickets restaurant de 9,50 euros - 60% pris en charge par l’employeur (à partir de 2 mois de stage)
- Prise en charge de 75% d’un abonnement de transport en commun mensuel ou prime mobilité durable (sous conditions)
- MGAme : challenges et événements internes

Le process de recrutement

Un premier échange téléphonique avec le service RH.

Une visite dans nos locaux : entretien RH et rencontre avec ton tuteur Sylvain.

Tu auras la possibilité si tu le souhaites, d’échanger avec un.e alternant.e tout au long du processus de recrutement.

Retour rapide et onboarding personnalisé : Tu auras un parcours d’intégration sur-mesure afin de découvrir l’ensemble des activités et rencontrer tes nouveaux collègues !Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our platform brings leading AI models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral, together in one place, allowing employees to use the right AI tools for their tasks while keeping everything secure, controlled, and connected to the software they already use. By helping businesses manage AI more effectively, we enable them to save time, reduce costs, and improve productivity.

We work through our partners, including Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs), who bring Goodweek’s platform to their own customers.

Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds.

The role

As a Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of our field marketing activities (trade shows and international events), paid acquisition campaigns (LinkedIn Ads and budget management), visual design and branding, and content localization across our target markets.

You will be part of a growing team where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we present our brand and reach new audiences. We’re looking for a hands-on and versatile person who enjoys both developing ideas and putting them into practice. You should be comfortable moving between planning marketing initiatives and managing their day-to-day execution, from creating visuals to coordinating events and running campaigns.

Tasks

Trade Shows & Events

- Plan and coordinate Goodweek’s participation in international trade shows and industry events.

- Manage all event logistics and visual branding, including booth design, signage, branded merchandise, localized brochures, interactive activities, and contests.

- Coordinate external vendors and suppliers to ensure smooth event execution.

- Organise networking events, partner meetups, and cocktail receptions alongside major industry events.

- Represent Goodweek on-site, engaging with prospects, partners, and industry professionals.

Localisation, Multilingual Adaptation & Content Rollout

- Manage the localization and adaptation of marketing materials across Goodweek’s target markets.

- Develop scalable processes to roll out localized content efficiently, using multilingual templates and automated asset creation where possible.

- Ensure brand consistency and maintain high-quality standards across all translated and adapted content before publication.

Digital Acquisition & Budget Management

- Develop and execute paid acquisition campaigns for each target market using LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

- Manage the overall acquisition budget and continuously optimize cost per lead (CPL) and marketing-qualified lead (MQL) generation across regions.

- Represent the partner marketing perspective in program design, working with Rev team, Operations, and Legal on how benefits, MDF, and tier criteria will work in practice.

- Build joint marketing plan templates for reseller partners, including campaign calendars and success metrics.

- Run Distributor-led acquisition campaigns using co-branded and localized kits for each market, and help Distributors customize them for their own MSP clients.

- Own Partner Marketing Funds (MDF) end to end: coordinate with Revenue Sales team on MDF, help Distributors build proposals, track approvals and documentation, and connect every funded activity to registered pipeline.

- Define KPIs, track campaign ROI, and prepare monthly performance reports and dashboards.

- Create, optimise, and A/B test localized landing pages and conversion forms to improve campaign performance.

Marketing Automation & Workflow Optimisation

- Create automated lead follow-ups, including multilingual emails within 48 hours after events.

- Scale global communication workflows and develop modular email templates that can be adapted across markets.

- Automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve the efficiency of campaign execution.

Brand, Design & Content Production

- Create visual assets for the business, including advertising banners, infographics, print materials, and event signage.

- Support organic LinkedIn growth by developing engaging post formats, carousels, key takeaways, and live event coverage.

- Create and coordinate high-value marketing content, including customer case studies, blog articles, and lead-generation materials such as use cases and customer testimonials.

Requirements

- Proficiency in English and either Spanish or French.

- 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing or communications, ideally with initial experience in an international environment.

- Advanced experience in design tools such as Canva.

- Hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across multiple countries, particularly LinkedIn Ads, and working with marketing automation platforms.

- Strong organizational skills and a structured approach to managing multilingual marketing assets across different markets.

- Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, adapt quickly, and reprioritize when needed.

- Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a hands-on approach to execution.

- Genuine enthusiasm for meeting and engaging with international prospects and partners at trade shows and industry events.

Benefits

- Health insurance provided by the employer

- Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)

- Flexible working hours

- Hybrid remote work

- Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain

title: Content Creator – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
description:
À propos de Culinary Agency

Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ?

Chez Culinary Agency, nous accompagnons des établissements et des marques d’exception dans leur stratégie de communication et leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique.

Vos missions

En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients.

1. Organisation et préparation des tournages

- Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients.

- Préparer les besoins en amont : idées de contenus, séquences, matériel et organisation logistique.

- Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings.

2. Création de contenus vidéo

- Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium.

- Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels).

- Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné.

- Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.

- Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients.

3. Montage et post-production

- Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats.

- Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels.

- Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients.

4. Suivi, coordination et relation client

- Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients.

- Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production.

- Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence.

- Développer une relation de confiance avec les clients, en étant leur interlocuteur privilégié lors des tournages et en assurant un suivi de qualité.

- Créer un lien humain fort avec les clients, comprendre leurs attentes et leurs univers, et savoir s'adapter à leurs personnalités.

- Représenter l'agence auprès de clients et de personnalités de premier plan, parfois connues, et contribuer à construire des relations professionnelles durables.

La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain, capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre.

title: Responsable HSE Data Center (H/F) – Multi-sites
description:
Responsable HSE (H/F) – Multi-sites France

L’entreprise
Notre client est un acteur international de référence dans les infrastructures numériques et l’hébergement de données. Il exploite plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, au cœur de l’économie digitale. Dans le cadre de son développement, il recrute sa/son Responsable HSE.

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous définissez, déployez et animez la politique Hygiène, Santé, Sécurité et Environnement sur l’ensemble des sites français. Vous êtes le garant de la conformité réglementaire, de la maîtrise des risques et de l’amélioration continue de la performance HSE. Vous travaillez aux côtés des équipes opérationnelles, des projets et des prestataires pour faire vivre une culture sécurité exigeante et partagée.

Vos responsabilités

Stratégie et pilotage HSE

- Élaborer et faire évoluer la politique HSE, en cohérence avec la stratégie, la réglementation et les référentiels ISO

- Fixer les objectifs et priorités HSE à court, moyen et long terme, puis les décliner en standards, procédures et plans d’actions

- Conseiller la Direction et les managers sur toute décision ayant un impact HSE

- Définir les indicateurs, analyser les résultats et assurer le reporting auprès des instances de gouvernance

Culture sécurité et système de management

- Promouvoir une culture de prévention fondée sur l’exemplarité et la remontée des situations dangereuses

- Rédiger et harmoniser les procédures, consignes et supports HSE

- Piloter le programme d’audits internes et le traitement des non-conformités

- Définir les besoins de formation avec les managers et les RH, et animer accueils sécurité, causeries et campagnes de prévention

Conformité réglementaire

- Assurer la veille réglementaire (santé-sécurité au travail, environnement)

- Évaluer la conformité des sites et piloter les plans de mise en conformité (Code du travail, ICPE, ISO, standards internes)

- Préparer les inspections et audits, et être l’interlocuteur des organismes de contrôle et des autorités

Prévention des risques

- Évaluer les risques professionnels et contribuer à la mise à jour du DUERP

- Superviser plans de prévention, protocoles de sécurité, permis de travail et analyses de risques

- Garantir la maîtrise des activités à risque : travaux électriques, en hauteur, en espaces confinés, par point chaud, manutentions, produits chimiques

Gestion des événements HSE

- Organiser la déclaration et l’analyse des accidents, presqu’accidents et situations dangereuses

- Piloter les analyses de causes profondes et suivre l’efficacité des actions correctives

- Contribuer aux plans d’urgence, à la gestion de crise et aux exercices de sécurité

Environnement

- Identifier et évaluer les aspects et impacts environnementaux

- Piloter la gestion des déchets, des produits chimiques, de l’eau et de l’énergie, ainsi que la prévention des pollutions

- Définir les objectifs de réduction de l’empreinte environnementale avec les équipes techniques et RSE

Maîtrise HSE des prestataires

- Définir les exigences HSE applicables aux sous-traitants et fournisseurs

- Vérifier habilitations et documents avant intervention, réaliser inspections terrain et audits

- Suivre la clôture des écarts et contribuer à l’évaluation de la performance HSE des fournisseurs

Votre profil

- Formation Bac+5 en HSE, QHSE, prévention des risques ou environnement

- Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) sur un poste similaire, idéalement en environnement multi-sites, industriel ou technique

- Solide maîtrise de la réglementation HSE, de l’ICPE et des normes ISO 45001 / ISO 14001

- Expérience de la gestion des entreprises extérieures et des travaux à risque

- Leadership, pédagogie et sens du terrain : vous savez convaincre aussi bien la Direction que les équipes opérationnelles

- Anglais professionnel apprécié dans un contexte international

Conditions - Avantages :

Bonus /an : 2 mois de salaire si atteint

Indemnité multi sites : 1 500 euros annuel

Participation (1,5 mois de salaire)

Rejoignez un environnement exigeant, à fort enjeu, où la sécurité et l’environnement sont au cœur de la performance.

Product Owner – Digital Assets (H/F) 

About Horizon Trading Solutions 

Horizon Trading Solutions is an independent global technology company focused on electronic trading, supporting agency and principal business goals across equities and derivatives. For over 20 years, we have equipped leading capital market participants with algorithmic trading technology and direct connectivity to more than 80 exchanges worldwide. 

We are currently looking for a Product Owner – Digital Assets to join our Product Management team and define, structure and drive the development of Digital Assets capabilities within our existing multi-asset trading platform. This newly created role combines product strategy and execution: the first objective is to structure and define the Digital Assets scope, build the roadmap and position the offer through market and competitive analysis, before leading its implementation and acting as the internal reference point on Digital Assets topics.

If you join us, you will: 

Product Strategy & Build (Primary Focus) 

  • Define the Digital Assets product vision and positioning
  • Build and maintain the Digital Assets roadmap 
  • Conduct market and competitive analysis 
  • Identify relevant use cases aligned with our existing client base 
  • Define how Digital Assets capabilities integrate within our current architecture
  • Assess regulatory and compliance implications related to Digital Assets initiatives 

Product Delivery 

  • Translate product vision into clear functional specifications
  • Own and prioritize the backlog
  • Work closely with Engineering teams to drive implementation 
  • Ensure alignment between roadmap objectives and delivery 

Internal Enablement 

  • Act as internal reference on Digital Assets topics
  • Support Sales and Client Delivery teams in understanding new capabilities
  • Contribute to client discussions when required
  • Help structure internal knowledge around Digital Assets 

 

 

Profile 

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Financial Markets, Electronic Trading or Digital Assets
  • Exposure to crypto markets, tokenization or digital asset-related projects
  • Exposure to derivative products
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Product Management or Business Analysis 
  • Strong understanding of trading workflows and real-time systems 
  • Ability to structure a product line and define roadmap priorities 
  • Awareness of regulatory constraints related to Digital Assets environments 
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments 

Technical Environment 

  • Multi-process core application (Java-based architecture)
  • Real-time and low latency systems
  • API-driven integrations (REST, FIX, messaging systems) 
  • Cross-asset architecture supporting equities, derivatives and evolving Digital Assets features
  • Close interaction between Product, Engineering and infrastructure teams 

Why Join Us 

  •  Contribute to the development of a new strategic product lin
  • Work in a highly technical and demanding trading environment 
  • Collaborate with experienced Product and Engineering teams 
  • International exposure 
  • Hybrid work policy 

Salary Range : €70,000 - €90,000 gross annual fixed salary, depending on profile and experience. 

 

Horizon is an equal opportunity employer. We promote diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion.

title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
description:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

title: Communications Officer
company: Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering - BIIE
description:
About the BIIE

The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region.

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences.

Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities.

This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

- Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials.
- Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content.
- Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics.

Website & Social Media

- Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date.
- Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling.
- Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Internal Communications

- Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged.
- Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials.
- Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Events

- Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring.
- Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM.
- Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities.
- Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities.

Communications Strategy & General Support

- Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities.
- Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials.
- Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute.

Required Qualifications

Essential

- University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field.
- At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role.
- Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German.
- Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels.
- Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences.
- Strong organisational and project management skills.
- Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts.
- A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation.

Preferred

- Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE.
- Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics.
- Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
- Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content.
- Additional languages apart from English and German.
- Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.

Founded in 2010, Luware is a leading SaaS provider specializing in innovative contact center and conversation recording solutions. Our Microsoft-certified solutions are designed to streamline customer interactions. We're committed to innovation and growth, fostering a culture that embraces agile methodologies and flexible work arrangements.

We’re growing fast – and we’re hiring!

As a Technical Pre-Sales Engineer, you help customers across Switzerland, France, Italy, Germany and Austria find the right solution fast. You translate their needs into tailored showcases on our platform, whether by selecting, configuring or building them.

Your analytical mindset and creativity will shine as you run POCs with customers, guiding them in designing and validating their technical concept.

In this exciting role at our modern headquarters in Zurich West, you’ll proactively support our small, friendly and international Pre-Sales team with positive energy and creativity- hybrid working is a given with us.

We’re looking for a dynamic, personable and communicative team player to join us as soon as possible or by arrangement.

Your mission

- Work closely with the sales team and partners to give technical guidance to new and existing customers

- Discover, build, configure and maintain custom demo showcases of Luware Nimbus

- Develop integrations with the Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Azure AI Foundry, and third-party tools (CRM, ITSM, CTI)

- Configure AI scenarios with Nimbus Virtual Users

- Package showcases as solutions for reuse

- Write technical sections of RFPs and technical documentation

- Train and support partners in your market

- Build AI tools that make the team faster

- Attend trade shows and events together with Sales

What we are looking for

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field

- 3- 5 years experience as Technical Pre Sales, Solutions Engineer, Test Engineer or Engineer in technology and IT services

- Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365, Azure Platform and the Power Platform (Power Automate, PowerBI and PowerApps)

- Developer tools like Git, Postman and Visual Studio Code- are part of your work
- Outstanding communication and presentations skills in English and German (native level)- are absolutely essential, French is a huge plus, Italian or Spanish is nice to have

- Strong presentation and demo skills, also in front of large groups- mandatory

- Strong analytical skills: you assess, test and design customer scenarios

- Microsoft certifications at level 200 or higher (for instance Teams, Power Platform, Azure) is a plus

- Experience with contact center, CCaaS or Teams-native telephony- is a plus

- Experience in one of the focus verticals: Finance, Insurance, Public Sector, Manufacturing) is a plus

- Experience working with partners or a partner channel) is a plus

- Hands-on with AI tools in daily work (Copilot, Claude or similar) is a plus

Our offer

- A fast-paced, international, and collaborative work environment
- A challenging and diverse role with high autonomy
- A motivating and supportive team culture where your ideas matter
- Excellent opportunities for personal and professional growth
- Regular team events and the chance to work from another Luware office for up to a month through our exchange program

You can expect a genuinely collegial, international environment and a fresh, dynamic, open corporate culture - let the Luware spirit convince you!

description:
Sie wollen nicht nur Zahlen verwalten, sondern mitdenken, gestalten und sich in eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe entwickeln?

Die 2022 gegründete curadmin AG mit Sitz in Rotkreuz ist ein administratives Dienstleistungsunternehmen für Organisationen im ambulanten Gesundheitswesen. Im Zentrum stehen betriebswirtschaftliche Dienstleistungen, aktuell insbesondere für die Hauptkundin solicare AG.

Wir sind beauftragt, eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit als Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen anzusprechen.

In dieser vielseitigen Funktion bearbeiten Sie anspruchsvolle Finanzthemen, erstellen Reportings, Budgets und Forecasts und schaffen fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Geschäftsleitung und Verwaltungsrat. Sie koordinieren und entwickeln Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Finanz- und Lohnbuchhaltung, HR, ICT und Governance weiter. Je nach Erfahrung bearbeiten oder koordinieren Sie zusätzlich Marketing- und Salesaufgaben. Sie sorgen für effiziente Prozesse, klare Abstimmungen, eine hohe Dienstleistungsqualität und die bedarfsgerechte Auslastung des Teams. Sie denken Prozesse digital und automatisieren, wo es sinnvoll ist. Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringen Erfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Controlling oder in der betriebswirtschaftlichen Beratung mit. Sie erfassen Zusammenhänge rasch, ziehen aus Zahlen die richtigen Schlüsse und vermitteln komplexe Inhalte verständlich. Erste Führungserfahrung ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihre Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und der Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und etwas zu bewegen. Die Position bietet Ihnen die Chance, Ihre Stärken einzubringen, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Bei entsprechendem Leistungsausweis eröffnen sich weitere Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmung.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Kontakt: Corinne Häggi, Nathalie Ramel
