title: Full-Stack Software Engineer for Web Platform .NET / 3D / ML
description:
Building the future of workspace design at Inspacion

Inspacion is a 100% bootstrapped ETH Spin-off based in Schlieren, Zurich. Our SaaS product is being used by major hospitals, manufacturing companies, and partners within Europe.

Our web platform and VR software currently enables whole teams in various industries, ranging from healthcare to manufacturing, to design optimal workspaces. As a software engineer at Inspacion, you will be part of a team building the future of how organizations plan and operate buildings with the use of machine learning, 3D web-apps and virtual reality technologies.

Your responsibilities

As a software engineer in our team, you will take responsibility for key parts of our web platform and solve challenges at the forefront of machine learning and advanced language model integration for building scalable solutions in an agile fashion:

- Architect, implement, and maintain technical solutions (web services, web UIs, data persistence) using cloud technologies.

- Fast prototyping, testing, and implementation of software components for machine learning approaches and Web3D applications.

- Take an active part defining both the roadmap of the platform and the long-term vision of the product.

- Deploy and maintain software and systems on-premises at customers where security and privacy is key.

Benefits

We are a growing company in the area of Virtual Reality technology and spatial requirement engineering. Join our team if you would like:

- Working in an innovative setting using state-of-the-art technologies (Cloud, Web3D, VR, LLMs) and become an expert in these fields

- Responsibility, creative freedom, and full involvement in creating a revolutionary scalable product

- Having a tangible impact – develop solutions that actual customers use and give feedback to

- Possibility to do product development from the start, including related business aspects

- Be part of a Swiss startup success story with global ambition

- And a company stock option plan, partially flexible working hours policy, free coffee at the office

What you bring

We are looking for an excellent software engineer who can master challenging tasks and gets things done. Apart from your ability to work in teams, you should bring along:

- High level of creativity with an agile and autonomous style of work

- Experience with the .NET web-stack: Blazor, WASM, ASP.Net, etc.

- Experience in building and maintaining REST-based web services

- Excellent programming skills (C#, RUST, or similar) and a passion for modern approaches in software development

- Experience in building solutions on cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP)

- Experience in deploying using containerization tools (Docker, container stacks, K8s or similar) and deploying to cloud and on-premises environments

- Background in data sciences and machine learning (RAG, LLMs, training)

- Big plus: Computer graphics background with know-how in advanced real-time rendering techniques, WebGL or WebGPU, Blender, game engines, and linear algebra

- Experience in database design (e.g. relational or vector databases)

- M.Sc. or higher degree in computer science (or a related field) / B.Sc. with proven experience in the mentioned fields

- Fluent in English, German is a plus

- You are eligible to work in Switzerland

Contact us

Contact us if you would like to know more! If you are motivated to work in a friendly start-up environment in the exciting field of machine learning and VR, do not hesitate to send us a full application (cover letter, contact details, CV, references, diplomas, relevant projects). Applications can be in English or German.

title: Data Science Internship - Wearables & Sensor Data (m/w/d) 80-100%
description:
greenteg AG develops high-tech thermal sensing solutions for an international customer base. In addition to industrial sensors, we provide a unique core body temperature measurement solution (CALERA®) for wearable devices.

Our technology enables a wide range of applications, including sports performance optimization, continuous and non-invasive patient monitoring, ovulation tracking, sleep analysis, and early disease detection and is integrated by various international customers on different type of wearable devices.

All solutions are developed, manufactured, and commercialized at our headquarters in Zürich-Rümlang, where interdisciplinary teams collaborate across hardware engineering, embedded systems, and machine learning.

Location: Rümlang, Switzerland

Workload: 80–100%

Start Date: Jan 2027 or upon agreement.

Important Note: You will receive a link with the confirmation email to fill out a form. We will not process your application if you fail to fill out the form.

Tasks

To strengthen our R&D team, we are seeking a Data Scientist Intern – Wearables & Sensor Data to help our customers along the way to successfully integrate our solutions into their wearable products. You need to understand the needs and demands of each customer and make sure that our machine learning models can meet their requirements.

Main tasks:

- Calibrate sensors and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models on customer devices.

- Plan and conduct data collection and validation studies.

- Analyze, visualize, and report model performance issues observed in real-world usage.

- Develop Python tools and pipelines to support customer integration and troubleshooting.

- Simulate model performance under varying sensor characteristics (e.g., noise, sampling rate, signal quality).

- (Optional) Support compilation and deployment of embedded ML libraries on target devices.

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or currently enrolled) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

Requirements

- Valid swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship

- Strong proficiency in Python with experience in scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)

- Solid understanding of data analysis, statistics, and machine learning fundamentals

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate real-world problems into robust solutions

- Ability to clearly communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- English proficiency at C1 level

Nice to have

- Experience with signal processing or time-series data

- Familiarity with C programming or embedded systems

- Experience working with sensor data or wearable devices

Benefits

What we offer:

- 20 annual paid vacation days (at 100% workload).

- A stimulating role in high-tech manufacturing, involving diverse technologies.

- Collaborative participation in enhancing company processes.

- An energetic and international team.

- Flexible worktime, option for 1-2 remote days per week (at 100% workload).

- Regular social events, teambuilding, BBQ, free coffee and snacks.

Interested? – Join us!

Send your application CV and a short cover letter.

description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Krieger AG Planung & Stalleinrichtung suchen wir eine/n Projektleiter/in Geflügel 80 - 100%

Ruswil · Festanstellung · Start nach Vereinbarung

Wir sind Krieger

Die Krieger AG ist schweizweit der führende Planer und Stalleinrichter für Rindvieh, Schweine und Geflügel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden erarbeiten unsere Mitarbeitenden Lösungen für innovative Um- und Neubauten. Die beste Lösung für Mensch und Tier ist dabei unser Bestreben.

Sie gestalten mit

- Konzepte entwickeln: Sie planen innovative und praxisnahe Lösungen für Aufzucht-, Mast- und Legehennenställe.
- Kunden begeistern: Sie beraten unsere Kunden kompetent und entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung für ihre individuellen Anforderungen.
- Projekte verantworten: Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für Ihre Projekte - von der ersten Idee über die Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
- Angebote ausarbeiten: Sie erstellen überzeugende Angebote und begleiten die Projekte auch in der kommerziellen Abwicklung
- Baugesuche & Planung: Sie erarbeiten Baugesuche, Konzepte und weitere projektrelevante Unterlagen
- Umsetzung begleiten: Sie bleiben am Ball und begleiten Ihre Projekte bis zur Realisierung und Schlussabnahme.
- Netzwerk aufbauen: Als Repräsentant/in der Krieger AG pflegen Sie den Kontakt zu Kunden, Partnern und Fachleuten und bauen Ihr persönliches Netzwerk in der Geflügelbranche kontinuierlich aus.
- Geschäft entwickeln: Durch Ihre fachkundige Beratung erkennen Sie Chancen, gewinnen neue Projekte und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden und unseres Unternehmens.Das bringen Sie mit

- Fachlicher Hintergrund: Sie haben eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Bau-, Technik- oder Landwirtschaftsbranche.
- Alternativ: Ausbildung als Agrotechniker/in oder ein Bachelorabschluss in Agronomie (FH) mit ausgeprägtem technischem Flair.
- Leidenschaft für Geflügel: Sie interessieren sich für die moderne Geflügelhaltung und möchten deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitgestalten.
- Technisches Verständnis: Sie haben Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und daraus praxisorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.
- Kommunikative Stärke: Sie treten gewinnend und professionell auf, können Menschen für Ihre Ideen begeistern und pflegen gerne Kundenkontakte.
- Verkäuferisches Flair: Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit und Engagement erkennen Sie die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und verkaufen erfolgreich.
- Unternehmerisches Denken: Sie erkennen Chancen, handeln lösungsorientiert und haben Freude daran, Projekte erfolgreich voranzutreiben.
- Sprachen: Sie kommunizieren stilsicher in Deutsch. Zusätzliche Französischkenntnisse sind ein Pluspunkt.
- Persönlichkeit: Engagement, Eigeninitiative und Lernbereitschaft zeichnen Sie aus.

Das bieten wir

- Interne Ausbildung
- Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel und eigenes Geschäftsfahrzeug
- Kollegiales Team und bodenständiges Umfeld
- Förderung und Unterstützung von Weiterbildungen

title: Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist, Post Graduate Trainee
description:
The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets
  • Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs
  • Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance
  • Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews
  • Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature
  • Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest
  • Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out
  • Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs
  • Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up
  • Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities

Qualifications

  • Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred
  • Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus
  • Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued
  • Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems
  • Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature
  • Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs
  • Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued
  • Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)
  • Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment

What We Bring

  • The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company 
  • Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients 
  • The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients 
  • Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback 
  • Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics 
  • A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines 

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Sales Development Representative (all genders) - Switzerland
description:
Wemolo ist Service- und Innovationsführer bei der Entwicklung der digitalen Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.500 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv und seit 2022 auch in der Schweiz.

Als

Sales Development Representative (all genders) treibst du massgeblich das Wachstum in einem unserer dynamischsten und wichtigsten Märkte voran. Du identifizierst strategische Zielaccounts in der Schweiz, öffnest Türen zu Top-Entscheidungsträgern bei Asset Managern, Retailern sowie Immobilienbewirtschaftern und schaffst so das Fundament für hochvolumige Deals unserer Account Executives. Dafür suchen wir ambitionierte Outbound-Profis mit ausgeprägter Leidenschaft für die Neukundenakquise, die eigenverantwortlich wertvolle Marktpotenziale erschliessen.

What to expect

- Outbound-Akquise: Du gewinnst neue Kunden ausschliesslich über aktive Ansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Account Executives.

- Account-based Prospecting: Du definierst Zielaccounts mit vielen Standorten, baust dir einen Überblick über Entscheidungswege und sprichst mehrere Entscheidungsträger pro Account gezielt an.

- Zielgruppen: Du arbeitest mit Eigentümern und Verwaltungen von Immobilien, Retailern sowie Gemeinden in der Deutschschweiz.

- Qualifizierung: Du klärst Bedarf, Entscheidungsprozess und Potenzial und übergibst sauber vorbereitete Opportunities an das Account Executive-Team.

- Outbound-Strategie: Du entwickelst Sequenzen, Messaging und Ansprachen weiter, testest neue Ansätze und misst, was funktioniert.

- Pipeline Management: Du steuerst deine Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse in Salesforce über klare KPIs.

- Multiplikator: Du teilst Best Practices, coachst neue SDRs und gestaltest mit, wie wir Sales Development in der Schweiz weiter aufbauen.

- Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Account Executives, Marketing und dem Country Manager zusammen, zum Beispiel bei Kampagnen und Messen.

Inspire us by

- Background: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium.

- Outbound-Erfahrung: Du konntest bereits 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung als SDR oder BDR im B2B-Umfeld sammeln und kannst einen klaren Track Record vorweisen, wie du deine Ziele regelmässig übertroffen hast.

- Kaltakquise: Du kommunizierst souverän sowie zielgerichtet auf C-Level-Ebene und überzeugst auch bei Einwänden mit Ausdauer und Verhandlungsgeschick.

- Methodik: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Sequenzen, Account-Recherche und Qualifizierungs-Frameworks.

- Netzwerk: Ein Netzwerk in der Schweizer Immobilien-, Retail- oder Mobilitätsbranche ist ein Plus.

- Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zielorientiert, eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert.

- Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fliessend Schweizerdeutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von grossem Vorteil.

What we offer

- Entwicklung: Du profitierst von vielfältigen Entwicklungs- und Wachstumschancen in einem dynamisch wachsenden Unternehmen mit klarer Perspektive Richtung Account Executive.

- Vergütung: Dich erwartet ein attraktives Fixgehalt mit einem nicht gedeckelten variablen Anteil.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: UI Designer - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

- Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

- Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

- Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

- Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

- Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

- Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

- Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

- Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

- 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

- Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

- Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

- Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

- Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

- High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

- Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Design Tools

- Figma

- FigJam

- Design Systems

- Interactive Prototyping

- Auto Layout & Components

- Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

- Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

- Obsesses over clarity, consistency and usability.

- Designs interfaces that reduce friction and build user trust.

- Works closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

- Moves quickly while maintaining a high standard of visual quality.

- Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

This Role Is Not For

- Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

- People who copy trends without understanding user problems.

- Designers who struggle to collaborate with product and engineering teams.

- Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

- Candidates who cannot clearly explain the rationale behind their design choices or their individual contributions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Switzerland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Switzerland.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Portfolio review

- Practical design task (if applicable)

- Role-specific interview

- CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

- Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

- Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

- Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

- Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

- You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

- You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

- Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

- Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

- Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

- Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

- Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

- Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

- Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Compensation: $180K – $350K • Offers Equity

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.

What excites you

- Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

- Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

- Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

- Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

- Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

- Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

- Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

- Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

- Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

- Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

- Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

- Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

- Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

- Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

- Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

- Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

- A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

- Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

- Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

- Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

- Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

- A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

- Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

- Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

- Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

- A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

- In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

- Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

- Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

- Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

- Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

- Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

title: PEGA Spezialist als Lead Business & System Architect (76037)
description:
Für einen Kunden aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Pega Lead Business & System Architect. Bei diesem langfristigen Projekteinsatz spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Geschäftsanwendungen. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit mit 5–10 Jahren Praxiserfahrung, die unsere Kunden bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung innovativer Pega-Lösungen begleitet und nachhaltige digitale Transformationen vorantreibt.

In dieser Position verbinden Sie Business und IT, übersetzen komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungsarchitekturen und überzeugen durch Ihre starke Beratungskompetenz sowie Ihren ausgeprägten Consulting Background.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Anwendung von Pega Blueprint in Kundenprojekten, um Business-Needs effizient in Architektur- und Umsetzungskonzepte zu überführen und fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Stakeholder zu schaffen

- Anwendung agiler Methoden (Scrum) zur iterativen Bereitstellung von Mehrwert und zur strukturierten Steuerung des Projektfortschritts

Nach der Einarbeitung werden Sie 2 Tage vor-Ort in Zollikofen bei Bern arbeiten. Das Arbeitspensum beträgt 80%.

- Fundiertes Anforderungsmanagement mit klarem Fokus auf die Aufnahme, Strukturierung und Validierung von Business Needs unter Einsatz von Pega Blueprint
- Exzellente Geschäftsprozessmodellierung (BPMN) zur Analyse und Optimierung komplexer End-to-End-Prozesse als Grundlage für Pega Case Design
- Praktische Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden (Scrum), insbesondere in der Rolle eines Business Architects innerhalb eines Pega Delivery Frameworks
- Souveränes Stakeholder-Management, um fachliche Anforderungen, Pega-spezifische Lösungsoptionen und Architekturentscheidungen klar zu kommunizieren und zu steuern
- Erfahrung in der Moderation von Workshops, z. B. für Pega Blueprint Sessions, Journey Mapping, DCO-Workshops (Directly Capture Objectives) und Lösungsdesign-Workshops
- Kompetenz im IT-Lösungsdesign, insbesondere im Kontext von Pega Case Lifecycle Design, Data Modeling, Integration Design und UI-Konzepten
- Ausgeprägte Beratungskompetenz und Kundenorientierung, insbesondere hinsichtlich Pega Best Practices, Pega Governance und Transformationsansätzen
- Starker Consulting-Background mit belegbaren Erfolgen in CRM- oder BPM-Transformationsprojekten unter Einsatz von Pega-Technologie
- Umfassende Erfahrung mit Pega oder vergleichbaren Low-Code/BPM/CRM-Plattformen (z. B. Appian, Camunda), inkl. Fähigkeit zur Überführung komplexer Business-Anforderungen in skalierbare Pega-Lösungsarchitekturen

Nice-to-have Kriterien

- Erfahrung mit Pega App Studio und der Demonstration von Standardfunktionalitäten und Workflows
- Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) in Kundenprojekten
- Pega-Zertifizierungen wie LBA, BA, SSA oder LSA von Vorteil
- Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams
- Kenntnisse moderner Transformations- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen im BPM-/CRM-Umfeld
- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Enterprise-Architektur- und Delivery-Teams

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
description:
Who is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks.

Main Responsibilities
You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory.

  • Build modern data platforms: End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost.
  • Engineer pipelines: Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in.
  • Migrate and modernize: Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over.
  • Make data ready for AI: Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on.
  • Run it properly: Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Advise and support: Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals.

Candidate Profile
Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production.

  • 5+ years in data engineering, including hands-on Databricks experience in production.
  • Expert Python and SQL, with strong Spark and data modeling skills.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification, or a commitment to obtain it within 6 months (we support you).
  • Experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus DataOps (Git, CI/CD, Terraform, testing).
  • Strong consulting skills: requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder management.
  • Fluent English plus French or German (both is a plus); eligible to work in Switzerland.

Nice to have: Experience with other data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery), dbt, MLOps, and industry experience (consumer goods, pharma, logistics, insurance, manufacturing).

Why Join Us

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Build the platforms behind boardroom priorities.
  • Swiss Impact: High visibility from day one on flagship programs, working directly with senior leadership.
  • Strong Tech Ecosystem: Certified peers across Artefact and close partnerships with leading data and cloud platforms.
  • Growth and Culture: Certifications, training, international missions, and a team of doers who move fast and support each other.

If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Tell us about your passion, curiosity, and impact.

title: Backend Engineer - Integration Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back.

We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code.

What you'll do

- Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements.

- Build great software: design and build clean, maintainable services in Go, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews.

- Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow.

- Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices.

- Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP.

What you bring

- 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

- Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly

- Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture

- Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code

- Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team

- Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike

- Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation

Nice to have

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code.

- Experience with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Google Cloud Monitoring.

- German.

What you'll get

- Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers.

- Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code.

- A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales.

- Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Senior Product Manager (Healthcare)
description:
Senior Product Manager - Consumer Health

Position: Senior Product Manager
Location: Zürich, on-site

Job Type: Permanent, full-time
Start Date: As soon as possible
Language: English (German is a plus)

About Us

We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. Our vision is to make complex medical data accessible, understandable and actionable for everyone through responsible use of AI. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.

The Role

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

- Define a roadmap focused on immediate "time-to-value" and features that amaze its users.

- Identify and deeply understand the needs, pain points, and user journeys of patients and healthcare professionals to design compelling and engaging user interface mocks.

- Engineer partner- and product-led growth mechanics for instant onboarding and shareable moments.

- Balance the fast iteration of a consumer app with the safety and quality required for medical software, consider privacy by design.

- Lead cross-functionally, measuring success by user delight, growth and retention.

What You Bring

- 5+ years in Product Management, ideally in high-growth startups.

- Hands-on experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

- Proven experience engaging directly with customers and users to understand their needs, validate ideas, and co-create product solutions that deliver value

- AI-native expertise: you know how to embed AI into the product and your own workflow.

- Experience with design tools and/or rapid prototype software, e.g., Figma, Lovable, Claude Code, to effectively convey ideas and explore options.

- Skills to prepare and deliver technical presentations to senior leadership and/or investors in an inspiring way.

- A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, structure ambiguous problems yourself and deliver, reliably and on time.

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven success building outstanding, consumer-grade applications in complex regulated verticals (e.g. Healthtech, Fintech).

- A technical background and/or deep technical understanding of common development processes.

Why Join Us

- Shape the product from day one. Take a core PM role on the founding team of an ambitious AI healthcare startup, with real ownership over the product, how we work and, later, the product team.

- Make healthcare work better for everyone. Help people understand and act on their own health data, and give physicians and partners the tools to spend less time on admin and more on care.

- Grow in the heart of Zurich. Work side by side with the team in our collaborative office and benefit from our network of industry leaders, domain experts, top-tier talent and investors.

Engagement Details

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, but strongly believe in the power and magic to collaborate most working days together in the office.

You will join a small team in a fast moving environment. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team initially.

title: Head of AI
description:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

- Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

- Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

- Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

- Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

- Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

- Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.

About You

- You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

- You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

- You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

- You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

- You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.

Nice to Have

- Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

- Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

- Je bent creatief, wist hoe je de juiste boodschap overbrengt op de juiste doelgroep

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen.

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time.

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.

What You’ll Bring:

- Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

- Experience working in a regulated environment.

- Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

- A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

- The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

- A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

- The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

- Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have:

- Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

- Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

- Experience with MDSAP

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

- We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

- We focus on execution and delivering results.

- We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

- We challenge ideas, not people.

- We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

- We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer

- Competitive salary including pension plan

- 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position

- Hybrid work model

- Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht

- Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

- Training budget

- Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it.

Are you excited?

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you!

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Our Team

We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story.

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.

Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.

We’re looking for:

You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one.

Our P&C team

Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time.

What you will be doing:

Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in:

- Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer.

- Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike.

- Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way.

- Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail.

- Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them.

- Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area.

- Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board.

- Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox.

Skills and mindset:

- (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa).

- Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact.

- Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment.

- Ability to work well in a dynamic environment.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Fluent in English.

Our offer

- A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s).

- A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office.

- 2 days of paid leave per month.

- We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection.

- 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship.

- A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers.

- Joining monthly borrels and other social events.

- The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact.

- Preferred start date 18 January.

- We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

- As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide?

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com.

You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one.

 

Our P&C team

Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time.

 

What you will be doing:

Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in:

  • Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer.

  • Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike.

  • Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way.

  • Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail.

  • Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them.

  • Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area.

  • Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board.

  • Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox.

 

Skills and mindset:

  • (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa).

  • Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact.

  • Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment.

  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Fluent in English.

 

Our offer

  • A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s).

  • A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office.

  • 2 days of paid leave per month.

  • We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection.

  • 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship.

  • A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers.

  • Joining monthly borrels and other social events.

  • The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact.

  • Preferred start date 18 January.

  • We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

 

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

 

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide?

 

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at 

 

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com.

title: Meeloopstage | IT Service Improvement & Klantbehoeften
description:
Wat jij doet

Gemeenten staan voor een uitdaging op IT-gebied, bijvoorbeeld de toenemende complexiteit van het landschap, strengere beveiligingseisen en een tekort aan specialistische kennis. Als Centric helpen wij gemeenten met deze vraagstukken. Bij deze stage ga je aan de slag bij het HPT-TAB team: High Performance Team - Technisch Applicatie beheer. Zij leveren dienstverlening aan gemeenten rondom Patches, Updates en Fixes en Technisch beheer.

Het team wil graag beter inzicht krijgen in hoe gemeenten de huidige dienstverlening ervaren en op welke klantenbehoeften wij nog beter kunnen inspelen. Je gaat dan ook echt bij gemeenten langs om in gesprek te gaan met de gebruikers en koppelt dit aan de services die wij als Centric leveren en kunnen leveren. Je spiegelt in het team welke behoeftes er zijn en hoe wij deze zouden kunnen leveren. Aan het eind lever je een concreet adviesrapport op over deze kansen.

Je gaat onder andere:

- Een analyse maken van de bestaande procesen en documentatie.

- Kijken wat de trends zijn binnen gemeentelijk IT-beheer.

- Afnemen van interviews met interne en externe stakeholders.

- Je uitkomsten analyseren op thema’s

- Mogelijke verbeteringen en commerciele kansen uitwerken in een adviesrapport.

Dit krijg je

- Een uitdagende opdracht met goede begeleiding in een informele werksfeer

- De kans om te blijven na je stage en door te groeien in jouw vakgebied

- Veel ruimte voor autonomie en het inbrengen van je eigen ideeën

- Borrels en andere activiteiten

- Toegang tot de Centric Academy om je ook al tijdens je stage verder te ontwikkelen

- Een fijne stagevergoeding van €550,-

Dit breng je mee

- Je studeert Business IT & Management of een commerciële studie met een affiniteit in IT.

- Je hebt affiniteit met projectmanagement

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed

- Je bent proactief: je bent niet bang om op stakeholders af te stappen of om je eigen ideeën te pitchen

- Je bent analytisch sterk en ziet snel verbanden.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Bij Centric maken we IT-oplossingen die je iedere dag tegenkomt. Of je nu inlogt bij de overheid, werkt in een digitale omgeving, of betaalt bij de kassa in de supermarkt: Onze IT ondersteunt de momenten die ertoe doen voor miljoenen mensen. We werken aan oplossingen die Nederland vooruit helpen. En daar zijn we trots op. Dat doen we voor de meest uiteenlopende klanten. Van overheid tot finance, retail en logistiek. En omdat we in verschillende sectoren actief zijn, krijg je de kans om snel te leren en nieuwe omgevingen te ontdekken. Hier vind je projecten met impact, getalenteerde collega’s en de ruimte om te experimenteren. Heb je een goed idee? Dan mag je het onderzoeken én uitvoeren. We houden niet van borstklopperij of grote ego’s. We bouwen liever aan oplossingen die werken. Voor ons, voor onze klanten en voor iedereen die daarop vertrouwt.

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de button. Heb je vragen? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze Campus Recruiter, Nicolle Barbosa, via of +31 06 106 39 927.

title: Meeloopstage | Software Developer
description:
Ben jij een hbo-student Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare opleiding en wil je praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele softwareontwikkelomgeving? Wil je meewerken aan een applicatie die door gemeenten wordt gebruikt voor het beheren van WOZ-gegevens? Dan is deze meewerkstage binnen het Scrumteam WOZ ABC iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als meewerkstagiair binnen het Scrumteam WOZ ABC (Afnemers, Bronhouders & Confrontatie) werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, het onderhoud en het testen van functionaliteiten binnen Key2WOZ. De stage biedt volop ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een professionele softwareontwikkelomgeving, waarbij werkzaamheden worden afgestemd op kennis, ervaring en leerdoelen. De focus ligt op actief meewerken en praktijkervaring opdoen binnen het scrumteam, niet op het uitvoeren van onderzoek of een afstudeeropdracht.

Omdat de stagiair volledig meedraait in het scrumteam en direct bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van onze WOZ-oplossingen, zoeken we een hbo- of wo-student met aantoonbare ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, opgedaan tijdens projecten, stages of een relevante bijbaan.

Je gaat onder andere:

- Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling en het testen van software binnen Key2WOZ.

- Meewerken aan reguliere werkzaamheden binnen de sprints.

- Deelnemen aan Scrum-events, zoals stand-ups en sprintoverleggen.

- Ontwikkelen en testen van functionaliteiten, passend bij de eigen kennis en leerdoelen.

Wij bieden:

- Een leerzame meewerkstage binnen een professioneel softwareontwikkelteam

- Een open en informele werksfeer binnen een internationaal team, waarin collega’s elkaar helpen en kennis met elkaar delen.

- Een stagevergoeding van €550,- per maand op basis van een fulltime stage (40 uur per week)

- Laptop van de zaak

Dit breng je mee:

- Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie

- Je hebt al enige ervaring met .NET en/of C#, bijvoorbeeld vanuit je opleiding, projecten of een bijbaan

- Je hebt interesse in softwareontwikkeling en agile werken

- Je bent analytisch, leergierig en communicatief vaardig

- Je werkt graag samen en vindt het leuk om actief bij te dragen aan een softwareproduct

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen.
