title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
Your next mission

Power our growing crew from day one. Keep our people operations running sharp – so every colleague feels supported, valued, and ready to aim high.

As our HR Operations Specialist, you keep the operational heartbeat of Robin Radar steady and reliable. You guide colleagues and managers through everyday questions while managing key processes from onboarding to payroll and pensions. Working alongside the Head of HR, you turn complex regulations into clear, smooth procedures that support our international team. You play a vital part in making our workplace an environment where bright minds thrive[cite: 1, 3].

What you'll do

- People operations and lifecycle management: Oversee essential lifecycle processes including contract management, visa and 30% ruling applications, leaves, and absenteeism. Ensure policies are followed while advising on necessary updates.

- HR systems and digital tools: Maintain and control our core systems, including HiBob, Odoo, and Officevibe. Act as the primary go-to specialist for system knowledge and drive continuous platform improvements.

- Onboarding and colleague support: Organise and host our monthly onboarding days to welcome new joiners. Deliver clear guidance to colleagues and managers on day-to-day queries with a customer-focused approach.

- External partnerships and compliance: Act as the direct point of contact for external payroll, pension, occupational health, and legal partners. Track changes in labour law to keep our personnel policies and handbook up to date.

- HR analytics and projects: Develop meaningful HR reports and analytics to inform people decisions. Lead and support projects, from implementing new systems to rolling out fresh policies.

What you bring

- BA/MSc or HBO in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

- Over 5 years of experience, ideally in international/multicultural settings

- Knowledge of Dutch employment law with a focus on migrant employment requirements

- Familiarity with HR systems like HiBob is a plus

- Fluent in both English and Dutch

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

- Team player with the ability to work independently

- Assertive and hands-on approach

- Proactive mindset with a focus on driving improvements

- Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate across diverse cultures and backgrounds

What we offer

- Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

- Comprehensive pension plan;

- Commuting allowance;

- 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

- Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

- High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

- An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.

What you'll be doing

- Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

- Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

- Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

- Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

- Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.

Your Profile

- MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

- Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

- Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

- Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

- Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

- Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

- Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

- Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

- Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

- Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

- Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

- Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

- Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

- Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

title: IT Helpdesk Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

- Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

- Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

- Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

- Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

- Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

- Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

- Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

- Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

- Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

- Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

- Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

- Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

- By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

- By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

- By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

- 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

- Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

- Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

- Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

- Meeting room and event AV experience with Zoom Rooms or similar systems, cameras, microphones, and displays, including setting up an event space or a new office together with integrators and vendors.

- Networking basics: Wi-Fi diagnostics, switching, DHCP, and DNS, enough to find the problem and talk to the vendor.

- Google Workspace admin basics and experience with a service desk tool (Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar).

- AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

- Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

- You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

- You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

- Availability to work from our Amsterdam office 4–5 days a week, with occasional after-hours support for events or planned changes.

It would be great if you have:

- An Okta certification (Certified Professional or Administrator) or experience with Okta Workflows.

- Freshservice administration experience: workflows, catalog items, SLA policies, and reporting.

- Light scripting or automation skills (Python, bash, n8n, or similar), or a real automation you built yourself, with or without AI help.

- Git and GitHub basics: branches, pull requests, Markdown.

- Experience with Q-SYS or similar audio processing, Logitech room systems, and Zoom Rooms administration.

- Live streaming experience for meetups: multi-camera switching (ATEM, OBS, or similar), audio mixing, and streaming to YouTube.

- UniFi networking and UniFi Access.

- A bit of Microsoft Intune for Windows devices.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

- 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

- 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

- 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

- 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

- 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

- 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

- 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

title: Implementation Specialist (German-speaking)
description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health, and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center, and for some a dedicated CSM.

When you're not delivering customer trainings, you help the wider team stay useful year-round: you build standardized video trainings based on the most common questions coming out of our support center, and you're available to represent Rentman at customer events or trade shows in German-speaking markets.

What you'll do

- Integrate Rentman knowledge with customer-centricity and commercial acumen to provide tailored training, in both German and English, that enhances customer usage, satisfaction, and professional services revenue.

- Deliver at least 60% of your time as direct, standardized-but-tailored training to customers, one-on-one or in groups.

- Lead Migration Packages for new German-speaking customers, taking them from their old system to go-live within 45 days.

- When you're not training customers, build standardized video trainings/webinars addressing the most common issues raised through our support center.

- Represent Rentman at customer-facing events or trade shows in German-speaking markets when needed.

- Always look for opportunities to expand and optimize our professional services and serve more customers in a standardized way.

- Maintain top-level knowledge of Rentman's functionality and industry challenges to advise customers effectively, and keep this knowledge current.

- Excel in administration and process efficiency to ensure internal processes (availability, booking, invoicing) run smoothly, and the customer journey is frictionless.

- Adopt a customer-friendly attitude and deliver high-quality training to ensure an optimal customer experience.

What we are looking for

- Native or very fluent in German and fluent in English. You're equally comfortable running a training in either language.

- Experience training or onboarding customers on a SaaS platform.

- You're curious about how customers actually get their work done and where the tool could serve them better.

- You take ownership of your pipeline and your numbers.

- You communicate clearly, both with customers and internally.

- You keep your training administration, scheduling, and invoicing organized so the customer journey stays frictionless.

Nice to haves

- You've worked inside the AV, production company, or event rental industry and know its workflows from the inside. This is what lets you speak credibly to customers about how they run their business, not just how the software works.

- Familiarity with Rentman or similar equipment rental or event management software.

- Exposure to more than one segment, such as dry hire, staging, broadcast, or corporate AV.

- An existing network in the German/DACH AV and event industry.

What you’ll get

- Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

- A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

- 25 vacation days to recharge

- Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

- A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

- Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

- Pension plan through BrightPensioen

- An annual training budget to grow your skills

- Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

- Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

- Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

- An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

- An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

- A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

- An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

- Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30-45 mins)

- Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

- A take home assignment (max 120 mins)

- Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

Apply now! For questions or additional information, contact us at

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health, and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center, and for some a dedicated CSM.

title: Anti-Financial Crime Analyst - Dutch & German Speaker
description:
Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Analyst (DE) in our Amsterdam office to investigate and report suspicious activities, ensuring Qonto's compliance with German AML/CFT regulations. You'll join our Anti-Financial Crime team and work closely with Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD, to protect our growing German client base from financial crime risks.

➡️ What you'll do

- Investigate and report: Perform enhanced investigations on suspicious client activities and issue Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to the German FIU when necessary.

- Ensure reporting quality: Detect and describe patterns on investigated accounts to ensure regulatory reports meet the highest standards.

- Handle team escalations: Investigate cases escalated by the transaction monitoring team, assess risk, and recommend next steps.

- Strengthen the AFC framework: Contribute to improving investigation processes and documentation standards as Qonto's German operations scale.

➡️ What we're looking for

- AML/Financial Crime experience: You have first experience in AML, Financial Crime, or Compliance — ideally in fintech or banking. You've handled real cases, not just studied the theory.

- Analytical rigor: You have a logical mind and can analyze complex datasets, spot errors, and build well-reasoned investigation conclusions.

- Quality and throughput: You deliver high-quality work while managing multiple cases in parallel — you know how to prioritise without cutting corners.

- Language proficiency: Fluency in English, Dutch and German is required for this role.

➡️ What we can offer you

- Real investigative work: You'll handle STRs, enhanced due diligence, and escalation reviews — not back-office monitoring. The cases are complex and the stakes are real.

- A market you'll help build: Qonto's German AFC processes were built from scratch. You'll contribute to an operation that's still being shaped, not just maintained.

- Investigative culture: The team values logical thinking and curiosity — understanding the why behind a transaction matters more than ticking a checklist.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Ludmila Moroniewicz, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Germany & CDD.

- Her path? 9 years in Money Laundering prevention in fintech — from KYC/KYB roles to AFC Lead, reporting directly to the MLRO of Qonto's German branch. She contributed to launching Qonto's operations in Germany and built the Financial Crime processes for the German market from scratch. Her Global CDD Expert role gave her an overview of KYC/KYB processes across all Qonto markets.

- What does she bring to the team? A hands-on leadership style that fosters continuous learning and professional growth. She knows the German regulatory landscape inside out and gives her team the autonomy to own their investigations.

[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.

What you’ll get

- A competitive salary based on experience

- 25 vacation days per year

- Pension contribution

- Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

- A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

- Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

- A monthly Alleo budget

- A learning budget

- Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

- A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

- You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

- The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

- The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.

- What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

title: Marketing Intern
description:
We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Contentoo team and help us turn good ideas into things people actually see.

This is a social and content-first role for someone who likes writing, design, internet culture, and making things. You might be a writer with a good visual eye, a designer who understands content, or somewhere in between.

You'll work with our Content Lead and Content Marketer, and you’ll help drive social media, campaigns, thought leadership, and podcasts. You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

- Publish and schedule social content

- Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

- Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

- Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

- Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

- Help maintain our content and social calendars

- Upload and format content on our website

- Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

- Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

- Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

- Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

- Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

- You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

- You understand what makes something interesting on social

- You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

- You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

- You're organised and care about the small details

- You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

- You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

- You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

- You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

- Social and content strategy

- Brand and creative

- Campaigns

- Thought leadership

- SEO and AI search

- Customer and market research

- Events and community

- Product Marketing

- B2B demand generation

- Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

What you'll get

- A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

- The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

- The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

- A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

- Free lunch at the office

- Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

- A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

- A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Product Marketing

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

title: Product Marketer
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketer to join the Contentoo team and turn everything we build into one clear story that Sales can confidently take to market.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced product marketer who is genuinely interested in AI and what it’s doing to marketing and content operations. You’ll own the product story across our platform, AI capabilities, human experts, and managed support, and make sure the way we explain it holds up in a real sales conversation.

You’ll report to our Content Lead and work closely with our VP GTM, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You’ll sit in on product, pricing, roadmap, and release conversations, join customer calls, and brief our specialists across copy, design, and SEO when enablement needs to be made.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine AI agents, human expertise, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams, so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgment.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of your role is giving Sales a sharp, defensible story built on what customers actually experience.

Positioning & Messaging

- Own the development of our core product narrative and website messaging, defining clear propositions, use cases, and proof points.

- Show how our software, AI tools, and managed services work together as a cohesive solution rather than disconnected features.

- Ensure messaging across our website, pitch decks, and demos aligns without contradictions.

GTM Launches & Sales Enablement

- Package new and existing capabilities around defined ICPs, customer problems, and commercial value.

- Plan and coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS—from readiness and evidence to external comms.

- Build field-tested enablement materials (one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection-handling guides) based on real sales conversations, not theory.

Customer & Market Intelligence

- Join sales calls, discovery sessions, and CS check-ins to spot recurring objections, use cases, and buying triggers.

- Gather competitive intelligence and market trends to inform product, pricing, and messaging decisions.

- Push back constructively when internal assumptions don't match market reality.

Release Governance

- Establish a lightweight release process that separates early experiments from market-ready features and approved external claims.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who talks about what they shipped, not what they planned. Someone structured, with good judgement and the confidence to tell us when something isn’t ready to sell.

- You have 4–5 years of marketing experience, with at least 2–3 years directly in product marketing.

- You have a proven track record of creating or repositioning propositions, launches, and sales enablement materials that teams can execute without a walkthrough—and the outcomes to show for it.

- You take strong project ownership, synthesizing fragmented input and aligning Product, Sales, and Customer Success without formal authority or becoming a bottleneck.

- You’re genuinely interested in AI and content operations, able to speak plainly about what it does well, its limits, and where humans still matter, without hype or excessive technical jargon.

- You’re curious about customers and grounded, comfortable joining live sales calls to understand objections, and ready to push back constructively when claims lack evidence.

- You have native or bilingual-level English, live in or near Amsterdam, and can work from our Houthavens office 3 days a week.

- You also get bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS (especially hybrid platform/service models), AI-enabled tools, localisation, or agency workflows, or fluency in Dutch, German, French, or a Nordic language (nice to have, not essential).

Why you’ll like it here

- You’ll shape how the market understands a hybrid AI agent and human expert proposition, not polish someone else’s collateral

- You’ll have a seat in product, pricing, roadmap and release conversations, and bring the customer view into the decision

- Your work gets tested in live deals every week

- It’s highly visible: Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership will use what you build

- You’ll own the product story and website messaging, with specialists to help you execute

What you’ll get

- A competitive salary based on experience

- 25 days of annual leave

- Pension contribution

- Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

- A monthly Alleo budget

- A learning budget

- Lunch at the office

- Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 3 days in office, 2 days home, plus remote flexibility)

- A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

- A fun and International team, with regular drinks, boat days, and more

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

title: Software Engineer Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) - Amsterdam
description:
Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m)

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team.

Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users

- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools

- Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review

- Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships

- Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth

- Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

- You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions

- You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers

- You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind

- You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack

- You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship

- Eager to learn and work in a team of builders

- You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

- Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment

- Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities

- Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow.

Life at Doctolib Tech

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

- Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

- Tech masterclasses throughout the internship

- Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site

- Up to 2 days of remote work per week

- Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, along with dedicated training

- Discounted membership to Urban Sports Club

- Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market

- Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring

- Comprehensive health insurance, fully covered by Doctolib for employees and their children under the basic plan

- Free mental health and personalised coaching programme with our partner, Moka.care

Our interview process

- Coding Game (1h)

- Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)

- Feature Building Interview (1h)

- Behavioral Interview (1h)

Job details

- Internship (6 months)

- Amsterdam

- Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

- Start date: March 2027

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany | France | Italy | Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
Build the supply chain behind technology that is already operating at scale.

We’re partnering with a fast-growing defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As production and international operations expand, they are now building a more resilient and scalable electronics supply chain across Europe.

We’re looking for the Supply Chain Lead to build and own this function.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll take ownership of the electronics supply chain end-to-end from EMS strategy and semiconductor sourcing to BOM resilience, logistics and cross-border operations.

This is not a procurement coordination role or an established function to simply maintain.

You’ll help determine where and how products are manufactured, how critical components are secured, which EMS and semiconductor partners the company builds around, and how the supply chain scales with production.

For someone coming from the European semiconductor, electronics or EMS ecosystem, this is an opportunity to move from owning one part of a mature supply chain to building one with significant autonomy and direct access to decision-makers.

Responsibilities:

- Source and manage EMS partners

- Manage BOM risk, including allocation, EOL, pre-buys and alternates

- Build and maintain relationships with semiconductor manufacturers and distributors

- Manage logistics from suppliers and EMS partners to the company

- Manage logistics to customers in the EU and Ukraine

- Manage customs and export compliance

Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience in electronics supply chain on the OEM or EMS side

- Hands-on experience through a component shortage cycle

- Supplier and distributor relationships you actively use

- Working knowledge of EU customs and dual-use rules

Highly relevant: defence, UAV, robotics or other complex electronics environments; hands-on SMT manufacturing experience.

Why This Role:

- The interesting part is not the title, it’s the level of ownership.

- You’re joining at the point where the company needs to turn a fast-moving electronics supply chain into a scalable international function.

title: Hardware Electronics Engineer (UAV)
description:
Details:

- Location: Leerdam, Netherlands (hybrid or remote)

- Employment: full-time or B2B

- Level: Middle / Senior

We're partnering with a defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.
This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together, and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.
The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As the product line expands, they're strengthening the hardware team. We're looking for a Hardware Electronics Engineer to join this team.

The Role:
You'll design electronics for UAV components, primarily flight controllers and ESCs, and own the full hardware cycle from schematic to production-ready PCB. You'll take boards through layout, manufacturing outputs, DFM with fabs and assembly houses, and into the lab for bring-up and debugging, with your designs going into products that are built at volume and used in the field.
For an engineer with a background in power electronics or motor control, this is an opportunity to work on compact, high-current boards where design decisions have direct, visible impact.

Responsibilities:

- Design schematics for flight controllers, ESCs and related UAV electronics: component selection, power stages, MCU circuits, sensors and interfaces

- Create multilayer PCB layouts in Altium, including high-current power routing, thermal management and signal integrity

- Prepare manufacturing outputs: Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly drawings

- Support the DFM/DFA phase together with PCB fabs and assembly houses

- Bring up and debug prototypes, and fix issues found in testing

- Take part in peer design reviews, both giving and receiving feedback

- Maintain design documentation and component libraries

Requirements:

- 3+ years of hands-on hardware design experience (schematic and PCB layout)

- Strong working knowledge of Altium Designer

- Experience with multilayer PCBs and power electronics: DC-DC converters, MOSFET stages, current sensing

- Experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g. STM32) and common interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN

- Practical understanding of DFM/DFA and work with PCB manufacturers

- Lab skills: oscilloscope, power supply, multimeter, soldering and rework

- Technical English sufficient to read datasheets and write documentation

Would be a plus: direct experience with drone flight controllers or ESCs (BLDC motor drives, FOC); familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4 or Betaflight hardware ecosystems; EMC/EMI-aware design for compact, high-current boards; design for harsh environments (vibration, temperature); basic Python for test automation.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. - Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

- Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

- Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

- Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

- Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

- Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

- Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

- Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

- Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

- Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

- Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

- Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

- Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

- First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

- First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

- First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

- You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

- You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

- We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

- We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

- We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

- Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

- A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

- Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

- Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

- Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

- Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

- The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

- Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

- Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

- Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

- Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

- Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

- Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

- Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

- Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

- Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

- Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.

Benefits

- Competitive salary

- Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

- Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

- 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

- Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

- Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events.

- Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

- Extensive paid family leave.

- Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

- Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

- Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account.

- Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

- Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

- Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation

Ready to build something meaningful? Apply now.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
description:

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

- Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

- Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

- Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

- Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

- Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

- Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

- Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

- Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

- Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

- Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

- Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

- Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

- Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

- Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

- Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

- Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

- Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

- Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

- Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

- Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

- Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

- Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

- Een fulltime dienstverband.

- Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

- Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

- Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

- De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

- Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

- Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap.
